d0f8678ee8b0ccc054388809ad852a84d993a9b0.title: HITCH: Teaching a Vision-Language Model to Operate a Humanoid through a Whole-Body Harness
d0f8678ee8b0ccc054388809ad852a84d993a9b0.summary: Enabling vision-language models (VLMs) to control humanoid robots requires both reliable whole-body interfaces and knowledge of how to use the body that carries over across tasks. We present HITCH (Harness Interfaces To Command Humanoids), a harness in which perception returns the 3D position of any point the VLM selects in its image, and execution turns commands for the pelvis, torso, hands, walking, and gaze into whole-body motion with a learned tracker. We find that both measuring the scene and executing commands accurately raise task success. We then fine-tune a VLM on trajectories in which teacher policies solve five base tasks through HITCH, so that it learns how to operate the humanoid. Without task-specific trajectories, the fine-tuned model completes 51% of SIMPLE episodes and 42.5% of HumanoidArena episodes, and adding five trajectories per SIMPLE task raises its SIMPLE success to 95%. On a real G1, it carries a box and walks to a goal without real training data.

AI.tldr: HITCH 为人形机器人提供整套全身接口：把 VLM 在图像中选的点转成 3D 位置、把骨盆/躯干/手/行走/视线指令交给学到的 tracker 执行，并用教师策略轨迹微调 VLM。摘要报告微调模型在 SIMPLE/HumanoidArena 上的成功率，以及真机 G1 的定性演示。
AI.motivation: 让 VLM 控制人形机器人，一方面需要可靠的全身接口，另一方面需要可跨任务迁移的身体使用知识。摘要将这两点作为要解决的问题。
AI.method: 输入是 VLM 在自身图像中选择的任意点，以及针对骨盆、躯干、手、行走和视线的命令。感知端把所选点还原为 3D 位置；执行端用学到的 tracker 把这些命令变成全身运动。在此基础上，作者用教师策略通过 HITCH 完成五个基础任务的轨迹来微调 VLM，使其学会如何操纵这具身体。输出是可执行的全身动作，以及会使用 HITCH 的 VLM 操作策略。
AI.result: 作者称同时更准确地测量场景与执行命令都能提升任务成功率。无任务特定轨迹时，微调后的模型完成 51% 的 SIMPLE 回合和 42.5% 的 HumanoidArena 回合；每个 SIMPLE 任务额外加入 5 条轨迹后，SIMPLE 成功率升至 95%。在真机 G1 上，无需真实训练数据即可搬箱并走到目标（摘要未给量化指标）。摘要未报告与基线的数值对比。
AI.conclusion: 摘要支持的观点是：把全身接口与教师轨迹微调的 VLM 结合，可在多个基础任务与两个基准上产生非零并可达高成功率的操作能力，并出现真机零真实数据的迁移演示。证据边界是：成功率只在 SIMPLE 与 HumanoidArena 上给出，真机部分为定性描述，且无基线数值与统计检验。
AI.core_method: 用一套“点选→3D 位置→全身命令→学习到的 tracker”的接口桥接 VLM 与人形身体，再用教师策略轨迹微调 VLM 学会使用该接口。

key_results.finding: 无任务特定轨迹时，微调后的模型完成 51% 的 SIMPLE 回合和 42.5% 的 HumanoidArena 回合。
key_results.setting: 基准：SIMPLE、HumanoidArena；条件：微调 VLM 且无任务特定轨迹；基线对比：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Without task-specific trajectories, the fine-tuned model completes 51% of SIMPLE episodes and 42.5% of HumanoidArena episodes

key_results.finding: 真机 G1 上无真实训练数据即可搬箱并走到目标（摘要未给出成功率等量化指标）。
key_results.setting: 平台：真机 G1；条件：无真实训练数据；摘要未报告量化指标与试次数量。
key_results.evidence_quote: On a real G1, it carries a box and walks to a goal without real training data.

limitations: 摘要未报告与任何基线方法的数值对比，也未报告统计显著性。
摘要未报告真机 G1 实验的量化结果（成功率、试次数量、失败模式），仅有定性描述。

02de0527ff8b53c5a5b52e1ca76a4711d7b56271.title: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
02de0527ff8b53c5a5b52e1ca76a4711d7b56271.summary: Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D. 55735372ffd62f9395c9c66548e8b9aaa922f5cc.title: STEP: Spatiotemporal Training with Explicit Prediction for Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
55735372ffd62f9395c9c66548e8b9aaa922f5cc.summary: For perceptive humanoid locomotion, the relevance of terrain geometry depends on the robot's body state and how both evolve under its actions. Existing work has advanced terrain-aware sensory fusion and cross-modal prediction, improving how visual and proprioceptive information is combined and related. However, feature aggregation alone does not specify which cross-modal relationships should be learned, while prediction between simultaneous observations does not explicitly constrain their action-dependent evolution. We present Spatiotemporal Training with Explicit Prediction (STEP), a one-stage framework that jointly supervises cross-modal relationships and action-dependent state evolution within a shared control representation. Multiple learned queries aggregate depth and proprioceptive tokens into a compact policy state. Bidirectional masked prediction uses each visible modality to predict latent features of the omitted modality, explicitly supervising terrain-body relationships. An action-conditioned predictor maps the current policy state and executed action to the next fused state, with an exponential-moving-average target defined directly in the policy representation space. Simulation comparisons show overall improvements in terrain traversal over evaluated fusion alternatives and ablations, while depth-dropout and delay experiments demonstrate the benefits of both predictive objectives under degraded visual input. Deployed on a 23-DoF Noetix E1 humanoid with onboard sensing, STEP succeeds in 98 of 100 hardware trials across stairs, a 40\,cm platform, a 70\,cm gap, stepping stones, and backward stair traversal without rearward terrain visibility.

AI.tldr: STEP 用一个单阶段框架在共享控制表示内联合监督"跨模态关系"与"动作依赖的状态演化"，用于感知式人形机器人行走。作者报告在仿真中优于所评估的融合方案与消融，并在 23-DoF Noetix E1 真机上完成 98/100 次硬件试验。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出两个具体缺口：单纯的特征聚合不能规定应当学习哪些跨模态关系；而在同时刻观测之间做预测，并未显式约束这些观测随动作的演化。作者认为地形几何的相关性取决于机器人身体状态以及二者在动作下的共同演化。
AI.method: 输入为深度与本体感觉 token 以及已执行动作。多个可学习 query 将深度与本体感觉 token 聚合为一个紧凑的策略状态；双向掩码预测让每个可见模态去预测被省略模态的隐特征，从而显式监督地形—身体关系；动作条件预测器把当前策略状态与已执行动作映射到下一个融合状态，其目标由策略表示空间中定义的指数滑动平均（EMA）给出。相对摘要所描述的既有做法（特征聚合、同时观测间预测），改动在于把跨模态关系与动作依赖演化都放进同一个共享控制表示中联合监督，输出是供控制使用的策略表示。
AI.result: 作者报告：仿真对比显示在评估的融合替代方案与消融上，地形通行整体有所改善；深度丢帧与延迟实验显示两个预测目标在视觉输入退化时均有收益；真机上 STEP 在 98/100 次硬件试验中成功，覆盖楼梯、40 cm 平台、70 cm 间隙、踏脚石，以及无后方地形视野的倒退上/下楼梯。上述均为作者自述，摘要未给出仿真数值指标、基线名称或单位化的对比数值。

6c3cffde57a052e93ca44427a3be6744a1d0bf6b.title: Terrain-Indexed Motion Priors and Geometric Support for Extreme Humanoid Parkour
6c3cffde57a052e93ca44427a3be6744a1d0bf6b.summary: We present a progressive imitation framework that learns terrain-appropriate humanoid parkour skills and subsequently adapts their hand--knee support. Human demonstrations provide traversal behaviors, but their contact patterns need not suit a robot's proportions or the available support surfaces. Our framework changes the role of demonstrations across three stages: privileged imitation produces physically executable robot references; terrain-indexed adversarial motion priors guide skill acquisition; and geometric support guidance with a reduced motion-prior weight enables contact adaptation. Candidate-based precontact attraction and actual-contact evaluation guide support without prescribing a contact sequence. The deployed policy selects behaviors from onboard depth, proprioception, and velocity commands without an external skill label. On the Noetix E1, the policy achieves 96.34\% hybrid success in simulation and transfers without real-world policy fine-tuning, completing 29 of 30 individual obstacle trials and four of five hybrid courses. Support-adaptation ablations show higher traversal success for the complete adaptation stage on the tested terrains, while qualitative observations show changes in contact placement. These results support acquiring skills from demonstrations before relaxing their influence to accommodate robot-specific support configurations.

AI.method: 输入是人类演示，以及部署时的机载深度、本体感受与速度指令。方法分三阶段改变演示的作用：①特权模仿生成物理上可执行的机器人参考；②地形索引的对抗式运动先验引导技能获取；③几何支撑引导配合降低的运动先验权重，实现接触适配。其中用“候选式预接触吸引”与“真实接触评估”来引导支撑，但不规定接触序列。输出是一个部署策略：它从机载深度、本体感受和速度指令中选择行为，不需要外部技能标签。

82965fc8d5c2de300abdcca00e3c08eee1efd2f5.title: TactileLab: Sim-to-Real Dexterous Robot Manipulation with Efficient Shear-Sensitive Tactile Simulation
82965fc8d5c2de300abdcca00e3c08eee1efd2f5.summary: Robotic simulators that represent shear within tactile sensing are becoming increasingly important for contact-rich manipulation. However, simulating contact shear with high-fidelity deformable or soft-body simulation is computationally demanding, limiting scalability to large-scale reinforcement learning. Here we introduce \textit{TactileLab}, a scalable multimodal tactile simulation framework built on IsaacLab, with a particular focus on a new optical-flow-based tactile representation termed \textit{simulated tactile flow}. Instead of relying on soft-body physics to model shear deformation, TactileLab uses rigid-body simulation to efficiently estimate dense tangential motion at the contact interface, producing tactile flow fields that encode shear-relevant contact dynamics. This flow field complements geometric features from a contact depth field. We further introduce a novel policy architecture for jointly processing long-horizon proprioceptive signals and rich tactile observations. Across multiple contact-rich tasks, policies trained using simulated tactile flow learn efficiently at scale and exhibit emergent contact-aware behaviours. To facilitate sim-to-real policy deployment, we then propose a novel real-to-sim tactile translation method that maps real tactile image streams to simulated tactile flow and depth fields, together with a new tactile data collection method, and validate it across diverse tactile sensor designs. Using this pipeline, we demonstrate real-world deployment on tasks encompassing dual-arm and dexterous in-hand manipulation. Overall, TactileLab provides an end-to-end sim-to-real framework for scalable tactile policy learning, enabling diverse shear-sensitive manipulation across heterogeneous tactile robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 针对高保真软体仿真建模触觉剪切计算开销大、难以扩展到大规模强化学习的问题，TactileLab 在 IsaacLab 上用刚体仿真估计接触界面稠密切向运动，生成"仿真触觉流"并辅以接触深度场。作者称使用该表示训练的策略可大规模高效学习并出现接触感知行为，并通过 real-to-sim 触觉翻译实现双臂与灵巧手内操作的真机部署（摘要未给出数值结果）。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，能表达触觉剪切的机器人仿真器对接触密集操作日益重要，但用高保真可变形或软体仿真来模拟接触剪切在计算上代价高昂，限制了向大规模强化学习的扩展。
AI.method: TactileLab 是构建在 IsaacLab 上的可扩展多模态触觉仿真框架。它不依赖软体物理建模剪切变形，而是用刚体仿真高效估计接触界面上的稠密切向运动，输出编码剪切相关接触动力学的触觉流场（simulated tactile flow），并与来自接触深度场（contact depth field）的几何特征互补。策略侧提出一种新架构，联合处理长时序本体感觉信号与丰富触觉观测。为支持 sim-to-real 部署，还提出 real-to-sim 触觉翻译方法，把真实触觉图像流映射为仿真触觉流与深度场，并配套新的触觉数据采集方法。
AI.result: 作者报告：在多个接触密集任务上，使用仿真触觉流训练的策略能够大规模高效学习并表现出自发的接触感知行为；real-to-sim 触觉翻译在多种触觉传感器设计上得到验证；借助该流程完成了覆盖双臂与灵巧手内操作的真机部署。摘要未报告任何数值指标、基线对比或任务级评测结果，因此上述均为定性作者自述，其中关于触觉流带来学习效率优势的说法为作者主张而非量化结论。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与触觉策略学习而言，该工作把剪切敏感触觉仿真从软体物理路线改为"刚体仿真 + 光流式触觉表示"，意在降低大规模触觉强化学习的仿真成本，并提供跨异构触觉传感器的 sim-to-real 通道。但证据仅限摘要中的定性陈述：无成功率、效率增益、基线、硬件与延迟信息，摘要也未给出仿真与真机一致性的量化证据，因此不能据此推断性能优于其他触觉仿真或策略方法。

bef49628416577e125a2015615002920bebae2da.title: Time-Indexed Skill Success Models for Latency-Aware Skill Selection and Timing in Dynamic Manipulation
bef49628416577e125a2015615002920bebae2da.comment: 16 pages: 9-page letter with 4 figures and 2 tables, followed by 7 pages of supplementary material (14 tables, 6 figures). Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
bef49628416577e125a2015615002920bebae2da.summary: Robots that manipulate moving objects act on observations that are outdated when the chosen skill starts, and the best skill can change within a few hundred milliseconds. Skill competence models, however, predict success for a launch at the moment of observation. We propose time-indexed skill success models, which predict whole-task success when a skill is launched after a given delay. Trained on rollouts branched at a grid of launch delays, they let a receding-horizon planner select both the skill and its launch time under fixed or random latency. In a MuJoCo study in which a UR5e captures a sliding puck with three skills, the planner exceeded a static competence model by 2.8 to 6.2 percentage points at 100 to 300 ms of latency, including when that model was evaluated on point or sampled forecasts of the launch state. Across five complete runs (three training seeds and two distribution shifts), all 80 paired 95% intervals against four baselines excluded zero. On delayed launches, the time-indexed model was calibrated (expected calibration error 0.009 against 0.239), and pausing the world during latency overstated success by up to 23 points. On a real UR5e that captures a rolling ball after 0.2 s of injected latency, a static model trained in a hardware-matched simulator predicted 99% success on a prespecified subset of 35 delayed launches that it rated at least 0.8. Of these, 63% succeeded (95% interval 46 to 77%), and the time-indexed model predicted 56%. In this single-skill, predictable regime, a matched physics-based forecast was also well calibrated.

AI.tldr: 摘要提出"时间索引技能成功模型"：预测技能在给定延迟后启动时的整任务成功率，使滚动时域规划器能同时选择技能与启动时机。MuJoCo 中 UR5e 抓取滑行冰球的实验里，该规划器在 100 至 300 ms 延迟下比静态技能能力模型高 2.8 至 6.2 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 操作运动物体的机器人执行技能时，所用观测已经过时，而最优技能可能在几百毫秒内发生变化；但现有技能能力模型只预测"在观测当下立刻启动"的成功率，无法回答"延迟后启动会怎样"。
AI.method: 输入是观测（含技能与启动延迟），方法在网格化的一组启动延迟处分支生成 rollout 来训练成功预测模型，输出是"某技能在延迟 d 后启动"的整任务成功概率。规划器用该概率在固定或随机延迟下同时决定用哪个技能、何时启动。与摘要所述静态能力模型的差别在于把启动延迟显式作为模型索引，而非只评估观测时刻的即时启动。
AI.result: MuJoCo 中 UR5e 用三种技能抓取滑行冰球：规划器在 100 至 300 ms 延迟下比静态能力模型高 2.8 至 6.2 个百分点（作者表述为百分点，非相对提升），且静态模型即便改用点预测或采样预测的启动状态也如此。五个完整运行（三个训练种子、两个分布偏移）中，对四个基线的全部 80 个配对 95% 区间均不含零。延迟启动下时间索引模型校准良好（ECE 0.009 对 0.239），而在延迟期间暂停世界会使成功率被高估最多 23 点。真实 UR5e 在注入 0.2 s 延迟后抓取滚动球：硬件匹配模拟器训练的静态模型在其评分不低于 0.8 的 35 次预指定延迟启动上预测 99% 成功，实际 63% 成功（95% 区间 46% 至 77%），时间索引模型预测 56%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把"何时启动"纳入技能成功预测，使动态操作中的技能选择带上了时间维度；摘要给出的证据表明其在仿真多技能延迟设定下优于静态能力模型，并在校准上明显更好。但真实机器人证据仅覆盖单技能、可预测的滚动球场景，且在该场景下匹配的基于物理的预测同样校准良好，因此摘要不足以支持该方法在真实多技能、复杂动态场景中的普遍优势。以上均为作者报告，未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 在网格化的启动延迟处分支采样 rollout，训练一个以启动延迟为条件的整任务成功预测器，供规划器同时选取技能与启动时刻。

key_results.finding: MuJoCo 中三技能抓取滑行冰球时，规划器在 100 至 300 ms 延迟下比静态能力模型高 2.8 至 6.2 个百分点，且静态模型使用点预测或采样启动状态预测时结论不变。
key_results.setting: MuJoCo 仿真，UR5e 抓取滑行冰球，三种技能，延迟 100 至 300 ms，基线为静态技能能力模型；真实机器人未涉及。
key_results.evidence_quote: the planner exceeded a static competence model by 2.8 to 6.2 percentage points at 100 to 300 ms of latency, including when that model was evaluated on point or sampled forecasts of the launch state

key_results.finding: 延迟启动下时间索引模型校准良好，期望校准误差为 0.009，而对照为 0.239；在延迟期间暂停世界会高估成功率最多 23 点。
key_results.setting: 延迟启动条件下的校准评估，指标为期望校准误差（ECE），对照值为 0.239；另有
key_results.evidence_quote: On delayed launches, the time-indexed model was calibrated (expected calibration error 0.009 against 0.239), and pausing the world during latency overstated success by up to 23 points

key_results.finding: 真实 UR5e 上，硬件匹配模拟器训练的静态模型对 35 次预指定延迟启动预测 99% 成功，实际 63% 成功（95% 区间 46% 至 77%），时间索引模型预测 56%。
key_results.setting: 真实 UR5e 抓取滚动球，注入 0.2 s 延迟，预指定子集为静态模型评分不低于 0.8 的 35 次延迟启动。
key_results.evidence_quote: a static model trained in a hardware-matched simulator predicted 99% success on a prespecified subset of 35 delayed launches that it rated at least 0.8. Of these, 63% succeeded (95% interval 46 to 77%), and the time-indexed model predicted 56%

limitations: 作者报告：真实机器人实验处于单技能、可预测的状态，且在该状态下匹配的基于物理的预测同样校准良好，说明时间索引模型的优势未在该真实场景中体现。
作者报告：真实硬件上静态模型在模拟器中给出 99% 预测而实测仅 63% 成功，显示模拟到现实的校准差距；摘要未给出时间索引模型相对静态模型在真实硬件上的量化优势。
摘要未报告：训练 rollout 的规模与生成成本、真实实验是否覆盖 0.2 s 以外的延迟、真实多技能部署、推理开销与消融实验。

c8516f05bbc62500beac55caef941e9cc4b73632.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
c8516f05bbc62500beac55caef941e9cc4b73632.summary: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation? We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework. Images are tokenized by lightweight patch convolutional layers and evolve jointly with language throughout the backbone, allowing a flow-matching action expert to draw from instruction-conditioned visual representations at different depths. This simple change reveals a consistent pattern. Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover it. More strikingly, layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation. Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control. Together, these results suggest that embodied control benefits from access to visual representations across the computational hierarchy, rather than a fixed encoder output.

AI.tldr: NEO-VLA 去掉独立视觉编码器，用轻量 patch 卷积直接 tokenize 图像，让视觉表示与语言在骨干中联合演化，并由 flow-matching 动作专家从不同深度取用视觉表示。作者报告在受控比较中优于编码器方案，且动作关键信号常早于最终视觉表示出现（摘要未报告任何数值）。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 的默认前提是"感知先被视觉编码器压缩，动作推理之后才开始"。但操作任务恰恰依赖局部几何、边界、深度和细微状态变化等最容易被这种抽象削弱的视觉信号。作者由此提出：动作策略应当继承一个固定的视觉终点，还是直接访问仍在演化的视觉计算？
AI.method: 输入是图像与语言指令。方法取消了独立的视觉编码器：图像由轻量 patch 卷积层 tokenize，随后这些视觉 token 与语言在同一个骨干网络内共同演化，而不是先被压成一个固定视觉输出；一个 flow-matching 动作专家可以从不同深度的指令条件化视觉表示中取用信息，最终输出动作。相对所述基线的关键改变是：把"固定编码器终点"换成"计算层级中多层可访问的视觉表示"。
AI.result: 作者报告了三类定性发现，均未给出数值。第一，在受控比较下，原生（无编码器）结构优于基于编码器的对照；全量微调缩小但并未消除差距，且仅增加规模无法弥补该差距。第二，逐层探测显示动作关键信号常在最终视觉表示之前达到峰值。第三，在多种操作设置与分布偏移下取得更强、更鲁棒的控制。摘要未报告基准名称、指标、数值、单位、基线配置，也未说明结果是仿真还是真实机器人。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的含义是：动作策略可能受益于访问计算层级中的多层视觉表示，而非单一固定的编码器输出——这是作者基于摘要的推论。证据边界：全部结论为作者自述，摘要无任何量化结果、无基准与条件说明、无真实/仿真区分、无独立复现；"更强更鲁棒"属未量化的定性主张。
AI.core_method: 用轻量 patch 卷积直接 tokenize 图像，使视觉 token 与语言在同一骨干中联合演化，动作专家按需从不同深度的视觉表示中读取并生成动作。

key_results.finding: 作者报告：在受控比较下，原生（无编码器）结构优于基于编码器的对照；全量微调缩小但未消除差距，仅扩大规模无法弥补。摘要未报告任何数值、指标或单位。
key_results.setting: 任务为视觉-语言-动作策略学习（操作场景）；基准、基线名称、数据规模与具体条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover it.

key_results.finding: 作者报告：逐层探测显示动作关键信号常在最终视觉表示之前达到峰值。摘要未报告探测指标或具体层位置。
key_results.setting: 分析对象为所提模型的各层视觉表示；探测方法细节、指标与模型规格摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation.

key_results.finding: 作者报告：在多种操作设置与分布偏移下，NEO-VLA 取得更强、更鲁棒的控制。摘要未给出数值、提升幅度、基线名称或鲁棒性指标。
key_results.setting: 任务为多种操作（manipulation）设置与分布偏移；是否为仿真或真实机器人、评测协议与基线摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control.

7769d18b18cd7aa8e0944108de48b271dbbe1141.title: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
7769d18b18cd7aa8e0944108de48b271dbbe1141.comment: Project page: this https URL ; Github: this https URL
7769d18b18cd7aa8e0944108de48b271dbbe1141.summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. However, vision-language-action (VLA) foundations largely inherit visual representations from 2D vision-language pre-training, while spatial supervision is often introduced only during task-specific adaptation. Developing spatial understanding as a transferable foundation-model capability therefore calls for learning from broader robot experience. We present SLA, a Spatial-Language-Action Model that scales implicit spatial alignment to continual pre-training and maintains it during downstream post-training. Initialized from a pretrained pi05 policy, SLA jointly optimizes action prediction and alignment between intermediate visual embeddings and spatial representations from a frozen 3D perception model. We curate and unify heterogeneous robot datasets to support spatial learning across diverse embodiments, tasks, and scenes. To accommodate this diversity, we introduce feature-dependent gates that adaptively aggregate visual embeddings from multiple VLA layers for spatial supervision. The teacher further exploits partially available depth and camera calibration alongside RGB observations, enabling effective use of heterogeneous geometric annotations. Probabilistic state dropout encourages reliance on visual cues and mitigates overfitting to demonstration trajectories. All auxiliary components are used only during training, allowing direct reuse of pretrained VLA weights and preserving the original inference architecture.

AI.tldr: 针对VLA空间监督多局限于任务适配的问题，作者提出SLA，以预训练pi05策略为初始化，在持续预训练中联合优化动作预测与视觉嵌入—冻结3D感知表征对齐，并保持原推理架构；摘要未报告任何定量结果。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA基础模型主要继承2D视觉语言预训练的视觉表征，空间监督往往只在任务特定适配阶段引入。作者认为，要把空间理解发展为可迁移的基础模型能力，需要从更广泛的机器人经验中学习。
AI.method: 输入为跨本体、任务和场景的已整理统一异构机器人数据，以及RGB观测、部分可用的深度和相机标定信息。方法从预训练pi05策略初始化，在持续预训练中同时优化动作预测，并让中间视觉嵌入对齐一个冻结3D感知模型产生的空间表征；用特征依赖门控自适应聚合多个VLA层的视觉嵌入以做空间监督；教师利用部分可用的深度和标定信息；概率状态丢弃促使策略依赖视觉线索并缓解对演示轨迹的过拟合。输出是保持原推理架构的VLA策略，所有辅助组件仅训练时使用，可复用预训练VLA权重。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任务/基准、指标数值、单位或与基线的定量比较，因此无法给出效果大小或提升幅度。作者仅提出SLA训练框架并描述其组成，未在摘要中提供定量验证或SOTA数值声明。
AI.conclusion: 若作者所述成立，该工作把空间对齐作为可迁移的基础模型能力，通过持续预训练扩展到多种机器人数据，并避免改变推理架构。但摘要未提供实验验证，无法判断其在真实操作任务上的有效性、泛化性或部署效率。
AI.core_method: 从预训练VLA策略出发，在持续预训练中让多层视觉嵌入对齐冻结3D感知模型的空间表征，同时保持动作预测与原始推理结构。
limitations: 摘要未报告作者声明的局限性；以下为摘要缺失信息：未报告任何定量结果、基准、指标、对比基线或统计信息。
摘要未报告真实机器人或仿真实验的具体设置与结果，无法判断真实部署表现。
摘要未报告异构数据集的规模、本体/任务/场景数量、训练成本或消融结果。

0856871105caeba621e2eb163250a62b67c352fc.title: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
0856871105caeba621e2eb163250a62b67c352fc.summary: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.

AI.tldr: 视觉运动策略对相机视角变化敏感，移动操作中机器人难以从与示教相同基座位姿执行操作。MOMASPLAT 用 3D 高斯泼溅、前馈 3D 基础模型与基于运动学的动作重定向，重建静态场景与被操作物体并从新视角生成完整合成示教轨迹（含动态交互）。作者报告在 5 个真实移动操作任务上，平均成功率超过最强基线两倍以上。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习训练的视觉运动策略对相机视角变化高度敏感。移动操作中，由于导航不确定性、定位漂移与环境约束，机器人很少能在与示教采集时完全相同的基座位姿下执行操作。已有新视角合成增强方法假设场景静态，无法在接触后交互阶段重新渲染被操作物体，导致示教中最关键的部分得不到增强。
AI.method: 输入是常规移动操作数据采集中自然获得的多视角观测（作者认为其足以重建静态场景与被操作物体）。方法将静态场景与被操作物体分别重建：用 3D 高斯泼溅与前馈 3D 基础模型分别建模，从新视角渲染两者，再通过基于运动学的动作重定向生成几何一致的合成示教及其变换后的动作。输出是从未见过的机器人基座位姿出发、包含动态物体交互的完整操作轨迹示教。
AI.result: 作者报告在 5 个真实移动操作任务（含刚体与铰接物体、跨 3 个场景）上，对未见基座位姿的鲁棒性显著提升，平均成功率达到最强基线的两倍以上（摘要未给出具体数值），并在所有基线均失败的较大基座位移下仍保持非平凡成功率。合成示教的保真度是在仿真中与真值对比验证的（摘要未报告具体指标数值）。
AI.conclusion: 对移动操作而言，把动态被操作物体纳入新视角合成、并同步重定向动作，可能比仅重建静态场景更能扩展示教覆盖的基座位姿范围，从而减少大规模真实数据采集需求。证据边界：真实机器人上仅报告了成功率相对基线的定性倍数与“大位移下仍成功”，未给出数值、基线名称、样本量；保真度的定量验证仅在仿真中进行，摘要未给出具体指标。
AI.core_method: 把移动操作多视角数据中的静态场景与被操作物体分开重建（3D 高斯泼溅 + 前馈 3D 基础模型），从新基座位姿重渲染并配合运动学动作重定向，生成含接触后动态交互的合成示教。

key_results.finding: 合成示教的保真度在仿真中与真值进行了验证（摘要未报告具体指标与数值）。
key_results.setting: 仿真环境中的保真度验证；摘要未报告所用指标、基线或数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation

limitations: 作者报告的既有方法局限（非本文局限）：先前的新视角合成增强假设场景静态，无法在接触后交互阶段重渲染被操作物体。
摘要未报告：具体成功率数值、提升的相对百分比、基线名称、每任务样本量与统计显著性。

9b21c26e14a425375c369aebc2fbaed9d41732df.title: T3R: Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement Towards Efficient and Robust VLA Models
9b21c26e14a425375c369aebc2fbaed9d41732df.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable end-to-end robot control, but inference is increasingly expensive. Each decision processes hundreds of visual tokens, often across multiple cameras, leading to substantial computation while allowing irrelevant background content to distract action prediction under distribution shift. We argue that these issues stem from two complementary forms of redundancy: many visual tokens are spatially irrelevant, while attention over the remaining tokens is often misallocated. Based on this observation, we propose T3R, a Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement framework. In the first stage, segmentation-guided token pruning removes irrelevant visual patches to reduce computation and eliminate distracting context. In the second stage, saliency-guided attention biasing reallocates attention toward action-critical visual regions and language instructions within the retained tokens. Together, pruning produces a cleaner candidate set, while attention biasing further emphasizes the most decision-relevant evidence, yielding a better accuracy-efficiency frontier than either stage alone. On LIBERO-Spatial, T3R removes 85% of scene-camera visual tokens while essentially matching the unpruned success rate, and improves success by up to 7 percentage points under out-of-distribution object-placement perturbations. The timing comparison attributes 7.8 ms per inference call to pruning and attention-bias application. As input resolution increases, LLM-forward profiling shows up to a 3.3x speedup over the unpruned baseline. Evaluations across LIBERO, SIMPLER, and RoboTwin with three VLA backbones show the strongest accuracy-efficiency benefits in multi-camera settings. These results demonstrate that training-free token refinement is a practical approach to efficient and robust VLA inference.

AI.tldr: T3R 是一个免训练的 VLA 推理加速框架：先用分割引导的 token 剪枝剔除无关视觉 patch，再用显著性引导的注意力偏置把注意力集中到动作关键区域与语言指令。在 LIBERO-Spatial 上剪掉 85% 场景相机视觉 token 的同时成功率基本不变，并在物体位置分布外扰动下最多提升 7 个百分点。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型实现端到端机器人控制，但推理日益昂贵：每次决策要处理数百个视觉 token，且常来自多个相机。同时，无关背景内容会在分布偏移下干扰动作预测。作者认为这些问题源自两种互补的冗余：大量视觉 token 在空间上无关，而剩余 token 上的注意力分配又经常错位。
AI.method: 输入是 VLA 一次决策中来自（可能多路）相机的数百个视觉 token。方法不改动模型权重、不额外训练，分两阶段处理：第一阶段做分割引导的 token 剪枝，删除与任务无关的视觉 patch，既降算力又去除干扰上下文；第二阶段在保留下来的 token 上做显著性引导的注意力偏置，把注意力重新分配到动作关键的视觉区域以及语言指令上。输出是经过"更干净的候选集 + 更聚焦的证据"的推理结果，作者称其精度-效率前沿优于任一单独阶段。
AI.result: LIBERO-Spatial 上：剪除 85% 场景相机视觉 token，成功率与未剪枝版本"基本相当"（摘要未给出具体成功率数值）；物体位置分布外扰动下成功率最多提升 7 个百分点。开销方面，摘要将每次推理调用中的剪枝与注意力偏置应用计为 7.8 ms；在输入分辨率增大时，LLM 前向 profiling 显示相对未剪枝基线最高 3.3x 加速。评估覆盖 LIBERO、SIMPLER、RoboTwin 三个基准与三个 VLA 骨干，作者称多相机设置下精度-效率收益最强。3.3x 与 7.8 ms 均按摘要原文数值照录，未做换算。
AI.conclusion: 该结果支持一个较窄但有意义的结论：VLA 推理中的视觉 token 冗余与注意力错配可以被两个免训练模块在推理时处理，从而在不重训模型的前提下换取更优的精度-效率权衡，并可能在分布偏移下改善鲁棒性。证据边界是：以上均为作者自报，未经独立验证；评测在 LIBERO、SIMPLER、RoboTwin 上进行，摘要未说明是否包含真实机器人实验；"基本相当"没有给出具体成功率数字，因此不能量化精度损失。
AI.core_method: 免训练地在推理时先剪掉空间无关的视觉 patch，再对保留 token 重新分配注意力以突出动作关键区域与语言指令。

key_results.finding: 剪除 LIBERO-Spatial 场景相机 85% 的视觉 token，成功率与未剪枝版本基本持平（摘要未报告具体成功率数值）。
key_results.setting: 任务：LIBERO-Spatial；对比基线：未剪枝（unpruned）的 VLA 模型；指标：成功率与保留的视觉 token 比例；摘要未报告具体成功率数值与相机数量。
key_results.evidence_quote: On LIBERO-Spatial, T3R removes 85% of scene-camera visual tokens while essentially matching the unpruned success rate

key_results.finding: 在分布外物体位置扰动下，成功率最多提升 7 个百分点（percentage points，非相对百分比）。
key_results.setting: 任务：LIBERO-Spatial；条件：out-of-distribution object-placement perturbations；指标：成功率提升（百分点）；摘要未报告对照方法与扰动强度。
key_results.evidence_quote: improves success by up to 7 percentage points under out-of-distribution object-placement perturbations

limitations: 摘要未报告：剪枝与注意力偏置的具体实现（分割来源、显著性来源、阈值或保留比例策略）与超参数设置。
摘要未报告：精度损失的量化程度——仅称成功率 "essentially matching"，未给出具体数值、方差或重复次数。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

3885da4b616d672a7d3ef593b16c13bc71f1d174.title: GPWM: Modeling the World as 3D Particle Motion
3885da4b616d672a7d3ef593b16c13bc71f1d174.comment: 39 pages, 27 figures, 7 tables. Robert Ren and Matthew Bronars contributed equally (ordered by coin flip). Project page: this https URL
3885da4b616d672a7d3ef593b16c13bc71f1d174.summary: We introduce GPWM, a Generative Particle World Model that predicts how 3D scenes evolve by generating the motion of particles and rigid bodies over time. Unlike video world models that generate scene appearance, GPWM operates directly in 3D physical space. A single representation and architecture cover rigid, deformable, cloth, and granular materials, in both passive physics and robotic interaction. GPWM is an object-aware multi-resolution transformer that combines flow matching with diffusion forcing to generate coherent physical trajectories far beyond its training horizon. We train and evaluate GPWM on ParticleWorlds, a 25.5-million-frame corpus spanning diverse geometries, materials, interactions, and robot embodiments. GPWM outperforms the best prior learned-dynamics baseline in each of six physical domains, reducing prediction error by 31% on average. Breaking from the domain-specific setting of prior methods, a single Unified GPWM models these heterogeneous regimes with one set of weights, largely outperforming per-domain baselines and even surpassing our own specialist models in two domains. GPWM further generalizes to unseen geometries, physical properties, object counts, and rollout horizons. Beyond prediction, GPWM enables contact-rich planning by learning a generative prior over joint actuator-object motion. Instead of searching over unconstrained actions, planning searches the model's latent noise for interactions that achieve a desired object-space goal. With the same world model, noise-space planning substantially outperforms action-space search on pushing and picking, where complex contact sequences are hard to discover. Executed open-loop in simulation, the resulting plans achieve goal-directed manipulation without reference action trajectories or goal-specific policies.

AI.tldr: GPWM 不生成画面，而是直接在 3D 物理空间生成粒子与刚体运动，用一套权重覆盖刚体/可形变/布料/颗粒及机器人交互；据作者报告，在六个物理域上平均降低预测误差 31%，并可在同一位世界模型中通过搜索潜噪声完成接触丰富的规划。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型生成的是场景外观，而非物理空间中的运动本身；且既有方法多为域特定（per-domain）设置，难以用同一表示与架构覆盖刚体、可形变、布料、颗粒等异质材料，也同时覆盖被动物理与机器人交互。
AI.method: 输入是 3D 场景状态（粒子/刚体表示），而非像素视频；GPWM 以物体感知的多分辨率 transformer 为骨架，把 flow matching 与 diffusion forcing 结合，学习并生成随时间演化的物理轨迹（粒子与刚体运动），输出的是 3D 物理空间中的运动轨迹，可外推到训练时长之外的更长 rollout。相比既有基线，其改变点在于：在同一套表示与架构（甚至同一组权重）下统一处理刚体、可形变、布料、颗粒与机器人交互，而非按域单独建模。规划时，模型额外学习关节式执行器—物体运动的生成先验，规划不再在无约束动作空间中搜索，而是在模型潜噪声中搜索能达成目标物体状态（object-space goal）的交互；摘要未报告具体网络层数、训练细节或噪声搜索算法。
AI.result: 作者报告 GPWM 在六个物理域中的每一个都优于最佳既有 learned-dynamics 基线，平均将预测误差降低 31%（按摘要表述为相对降幅，未给出绝对数值或指标名称）。单一权重的 Unified GPWM 大幅优于按域基线，并在两个域上超过其自身专家模型。泛化方面作者称其可迁移到未见过的几何、物理属性、物体数与 rollout 时长。规划方面，噪声空间搜索在 pushing 与 picking 上显著优于动作空间搜索；所得计划在仿真中以开环执行即可完成目标导向的操作，无需参考动作轨迹或目标专用策略。摘要未报告真实机器人实验、延迟、算力或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型研究，该工作提示一条与视频生成不同的路径：把世界模型定义在 3D 粒子/刚体运动空间，用统一表示与权重横跨多种材料与交互，并把世界模型直接复用为规划的生成先验（在潜噪声中搜索而非搜索动作）。证据边界：所有结论均为作者在摘要中的自述，预测精度仅以“平均降低 31%”表述，未给指标名、绝对值与条件；规划结果仅在仿真中开环执行，摘要未提供真实机器人验证。
AI.core_method: 物体感知的多分辨率 transformer 将 flow matching 与 diffusion forcing 结合，直接在 3D 粒子/刚体运动空间中生成多材料、长时程的物理轨迹，并把该生成先验用于在潜噪声中搜索接触丰富的操作交互。

key_results.finding: 单一组权重的 Unified GPWM 大幅优于按域基线，并在两个域上超过自身的专家模型（未给出具体数值）。
key_results.setting: 对比对象为按域（per-domain）训练的基线以及作者自己的 specialist 模型；摘要未报告具体是哪两个域及具体数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: Breaking from the domain-specific setting of prior methods, a single Unified GPWM models these heterogeneous regimes with one set of weights, largely outperforming per-domain baselines and even surpassing our own specialist models in two domains.

key_results.finding: 在同一世界模型下，噪声空间规划在 pushing 与 picking 上显著优于动作空间搜索；计划在仿真中开环执行即可达目标，无需参考动作轨迹或目标专用策略。
key_results.setting: 任务为 pushing 与 picking；对比对象为 action-space search；执行条件为仿真中的开环执行；摘要未报告成功率等具体指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: With the same world model, noise-space planning substantially outperforms action-space search on pushing and picking, where complex contact sequences are hard to discover.

limitations: 摘要未报告：六域的具体名称、所用指标的绝对值、31% 的具体计算口径与实验条件；也未给出算力、延迟或统计显著性。
摘要未报告真实机器人实验：规划结果明确为“Executed open-loop in simulation”，因此不能推断真机可用性。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

34a824786eeb75d2811f3ea709e1442f3931a277.title: RoboARCade: Benchmarking Agentic Robot Control
34a824786eeb75d2811f3ea709e1442f3931a277.summary: Improvements in multi-modal capabilities have enabled agents to act directly as robot policies, a setting we refer to as agentic robot control (ARC). We introduce RoboARCade, a benchmark of long-horizon manipulation tasks across three embodiments designed to test in-context adaptation, memory, and reasoning for precise control. The tasks build on existing open-source benchmarks, which we make harder by widening the range of initial conditions. RoboARCade is easy to use and extend: all tasks run on a single simulation backend, MuJoCo, each task is a self-contained data pack, and agents connect through interchangeable interfaces, so new tasks, agents, and interfaces can be added independently. The benchmark separates leading agents: GPT-6 Astra achieves 49.8% compared with 43.6% for Claude Fable 5.1, leaving substantial room for improvement. Comparing two interfaces, we find that a richer visual interface adds only 1.5 to 6.8 points at 1.7 to 2.3 times the cost. Failures stem mostly from choosing a poor manipulation strategy or executing a good one imprecisely, rarely from misunderstanding the scene, and agents incorrectly claim success on 24% to 39% of attempted subtasks. Agents can also improve without human input: one successful demonstration in context raises Astra's score from 53.5% to 73.0% on a five-task subset, and a prompt the agent writes and revises itself reaches 72.0%. Code, videos and full traces are available at this http URL .

AI.tldr: RoboARCade 是一个面向"智能体式机器人控制"的仿真基准，用加宽初始条件的长时程操作任务检验上下文适应、记忆与推理。三维具身任务在单一 MuJoCo 后端上运行，可区分不同智能体（GPT-6 Astra 49.8% vs Claude Fable 5.1 43.6%），并显示单次上下文示范与自写提示可显著提升得分。
AI.motivation: 多模态能力的提升使智能体可直接充当机器人策略（作者称为 agentic robot control, ARC），但需要一个能检验长时程精确控制、上下文适应、记忆与推理的评测载体。作者指出其任务基于已有开源基准，并通过扩大初始条件范围来提高难度，说明现有基准在初始条件多样性上偏窄、难度不足。
AI.method: 输入是跨三种具身的长时程操作任务，任务由已有开源基准改造而来，通过加宽初始条件范围增加难度。方法不训练新策略，而是搭建统一评测框架：所有任务跑在同一个仿真后端 MuJoCo 上，每个任务打包为自包含数据包，智能体通过可替换接口接入，从而让新任务、新智能体、新接口可各自独立扩展。输出是各智能体在任务上的得分，以及可供检查的完整轨迹（trace）；论文还对比了两种不同丰富度的视觉接口。
AI.result: 作者报告基准能区分前沿智能体：GPT-6 Astra 49.8%，Claude Fable 5.1 43.6%，并称仍有较大提升空间。接口对比上，更丰富的视觉接口只增加 1.5 到 6.8 个点，而成本为 1.7 到 2.3 倍。失败主要来自选择糟糕的操作策略或对好策略执行不精确，很少源于场景理解错误；智能体在 24% 到 39% 的已尝试子任务上错误地宣称成功。无需人类输入也可提升：一次成功的上下文示范把 Astra 在五任务子集上的分数从 53.5% 提升到 73.0%，智能体自行撰写并修订的提示达到 72.0%。作者未在摘要中报告真实机器人结果。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与"智能体即策略"路线而言，该工作把评测重点从单一成功率转向长时程精确控制、上下文适应与记忆，并给出接口成本、失败归因和虚假成功率的诊断维度，同时提示上下文示范与自生成提示是低成本改进方向。证据边界：摘要只报告 MuJoCo 仿真结果，未提供真实机器人验证、任务数量与规模、样本量或统计显著性，所有数值均为作者自述、未经独立复核。
AI.core_method: 把已有开源操作基准的任务加宽初始条件后，统一收纳进单个 MuJoCo 仿真后端与可替换的智能体接口，用同一套长时程任务打分并记录完整轨迹。

key_results.finding: 基准可区分领先智能体：GPT-6 Astra 得 49.8%，高于 Claude Fable 5.1 的 43.6%，作者称仍有较大提升空间。
key_results.setting: RoboARCade 基准，跨三种具身的长时程操作任务，仿真后端为 MuJoCo；摘要未报告任务数量、采样次数与统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: The benchmark separates leading agents: GPT-6 Astra achieves 49.8% compared with 43.6% for Claude Fable 5.1, leaving substantial room for improvement.

key_results.finding: 两种接口对比：更丰富的视觉接口仅带来 1.5 到 6.8 个点的提升，成本为 1.7 到 2.3 倍。
key_results.setting: 同一基准下的两种智能体接口对比；摘要未报告具体任务集合、成本的计算口径与绝对数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: Comparing two interfaces, we find that a richer visual interface adds only 1.5 to 6.8 points at 1.7 to 2.3 times the cost.

key_results.finding: 无需人类输入即可提升：一次成功的上下文示范把 Astra 在五任务子集上的分数从 53.5% 提升到 73.0%；智能体自行撰写并修订的提示达到 72.0%。
key_results.setting: Astra 在五任务子集上的上下文学习实验；摘要未报告该子集相对完整基准的构成、重复次数与显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: one successful demonstration in context raises Astra's score from 53.5% to 73.0% on a five-task subset, and a prompt the agent writes and revises itself reaches 72.0%

383988f7f22ff1dcd2fb01048f53f7da1831fe88.title: Latent RL Priors for Data-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation
383988f7f22ff1dcd2fb01048f53f7da1831fe88.summary: Learning dexterous manipulation from limited visual demonstrations is challenging because policies must acquire both perceptual grounding and precise control, while reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation can acquire rich control behaviors from large-scale interaction with privileged information. We introduce \textbf{Latent RL Prior}, a two-stage framework that reuses this control knowledge for data-efficient visual policy learning. During privileged pretraining, we distill large-scale RL rollouts into a flow-matching action decoder conditioned on proprioception and latent task context. During visual adaptation, we freeze the decoder and learn a visual interface that maps images to its latent context using action supervision alone, without privileged labels or latent targets. The same decoder can further be shared across arms by learning coordinated visual contexts for bimanual manipulation. Across three simulated tasks, our method outperforms full-parameter fine-tuning of $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7 in the low-data regime; on door lifting and bimanual assembly, it surpasses full-data baselines using $10\times$ and $5\times$ fewer demonstrations, respectively. Further analysis shows that direct visual-to-latent conditioning improves adaptation performance and training stability over routing visual predictions through the pretrained state encoder. Robustness to unseen mass variation and greater linear accessibility of contact-force information in decoder representations further provide evidence of retained RL-acquired control knowledge. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 为缓解视觉示教稀缺下灵巧操作策略既要学感知又要学精确控制的问题，作者提出两阶段"Latent RL Prior"：先用特权信息的大规模强化学习数据蒸馏出以本体感受和潜在任务上下文为条件的流匹配动作解码器，再冻结解码器、仅用动作监督学一个把图像映射到该潜在上下文的视觉接口。作者报告在三个仿真任务上低数据量时优于 π0.5 与 GR00T N1.7 的全参数微调，并在开门和双臂装配上以 10×、5× 更少的示教超过全数据基线。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，从有限视觉示教中学习灵巧操作很难，因为策略必须同时获得感知落地（perceptual grounding）和精确控制；而仿真中的强化学习可以借特权信息通过大规模交互获得丰富的控制行为。作者的动机是把这类已获得的控制知识复用起来，以实现数据高效的视觉策略学习。
AI.method: 输入：仿真中带特权信息的大规模 RL rollout，以及后续阶段少量（仅视觉）示教的动作监督。第一阶段（特权预训练）：把大规模 RL rollout 蒸馏进一个流匹配（flow-matching）动作解码器，该解码器以本体感受（proprioception）和潜在任务上下文为条件。第二阶段（视觉适配）：冻结该解码器，只学习一个视觉接口，把图像映射到解码器的潜在上下文，且仅使用动作监督，不需要特权标签，也不需要潜在目标（latent targets）作为监督。输出：可执行的灵巧操作视觉策略。此外，同一解码器可通过为双臂操作学习协同的视觉上下文而在不同手臂之间共享。摘要未报告网络结构细节、数据规模或训练硬件。
AI.result: 作者报告（均为仿真结果）：在三个仿真任务上，低数据量情形下优于 π0.5 和 GR00T N1.7 的全参数微调；在开门（door lifting）和双臂装配上，用 10× 和 5× 更少的示教即超过全数据基线（摘要未给出具体成功率/误差数值）。两项额外分析性观察：直接做视觉到潜在条件的映射，比把视觉预测经由预训练状态编码器中转，获得更好的适配表现与训练稳定性；对未见质量变化（unseen mass variation）的鲁棒性，以及解码器表示中接触力信息具有更高的线性可达性（linear accessibility），被作者作为保留 RL 所学控制知识的证据。以上均为作者自述，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向的意义在于：把大规模特权 RL 的控制知识固化在一个以潜在任务上下文为条件的动作解码器里，再用极少量纯视觉监督接上感知，是一条面向数据高效灵巧操作的可行路线，并支持解码器跨手臂共享（双臂协同上下文）。证据边界：全部定量比较都在仿真中，摘要未报告真机实验；提升以"少多少倍示教"和相对基线优劣表述，缺少绝对指标数值、基线配置细节与统计显著性；鲁棒性与表示性质仅为作者报告的分析观察。
AI.core_method: 先用特权 RL 交互蒸馏出一个以本体感受和潜在任务上下文为条件的流匹配动作解码器，再冻结它、仅用动作监督学一个把图像映射到该潜在上下文的视觉接口。

1d4dfd35ab7d4debaf684e84f733846d200cb8fb.title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
1d4dfd35ab7d4debaf684e84f733846d200cb8fb.comment: 30 pages, 6 figures. Code: this https URL
1d4dfd35ab7d4debaf684e84f733846d200cb8fb.summary: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than Fast-WAM at comparable performance and outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to pi0.5 and above non-embodied-pretrained baselines. Through a design study of the choices behind La-JEPA, we show that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction choices significantly impact the policy even when future prediction is skipped at inference. We correct the LIBERO-Plus instructions, as the officially released evaluator corrupts them for most variants, and re-evaluate several strong open baselines. Without a generative pretrained policy backbone, La-JEPA is better and faster than far larger policies, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 La-JEPA：在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 特征空间里从零训练紧凑策略 Transformer，训练时联合预测未来特征与动作、推理只出动作。作者称其在无具身预训练的策略中于 RoboTwin 2.0 与 LIBERO-Plus 达到 SOTA，且参数远少于最强对比方法、速度显著快于 Fast-WAM；摘要未给出任何数值指标。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型沿用预训练视频生成器，VLA 沿用预训练视觉-语言骨干，二者都把策略结构与推理开销绑定在为"生成"而非"控制"设计的大 Transformer 上；这些生成导向的设计选择对控制性能的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 方法为 Latent Action JEPA（La-JEPA），一个紧凑的世界-动作模型：其策略 Transformer 不使用生成式预训练骨干，而是在预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器的特征空间中从零训练。参照 Fast-WAM 的做法，训练阶段同时学习预测未来特征与动作，推理阶段跳过未来预测、只生成动作。相对于视频生成器式 WAM 与 VLM 式 VLA，改变的是策略骨干的来源与规模，以及推理时不再做生成。摘要未说明具体输入模态、数据规模与训练细节。
AI.result: 作者报告：在无具身预训练的策略中，La-JEPA 在干净与随机化的 RoboTwin 2.0 场景以及指令修正后的 LIBERO-Plus 上取得 SOTA，且参数远少于最强竞争策略；在性能相当的情况下速度显著快于 Fast-WAM；在不使用对方预训练策略骨干的条件下，于 LIBERO-Plus 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上超过最接近的 JEPA 类方法 LeapBot-WA 与 JEPA-WAM。四个真机任务上平均成功率与 pi0.5 相当、高于无具身预训练的基线。设计研究显示 JEPA 特征优于视频 VAE 潜变量（分布外时最明显），且训练期未来预测的设计选择会显著影响策略，即便推理时跳过未来预测。作者还指出 LIBERO-Plus 官方评测器对多数变体损坏了指令，因此修正指令并重评了若干强开源基线。上述均为作者声明，摘要未报告任何数值、单位或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型研究而言，该工作提示：策略不必继承生成式大骨干，在 JEPA 式潜空间特征中从零训练小策略、并用"训练期预测未来特征、推理期不预测"的方式，可能同时获得更强控制与更低推理成本，且潜空间特征可能比视频 VAE 潜变量更利于控制，尤其是分布外场景。证据限于摘要中的定性声明，缺少数值、真机逐任务结果与效率测量，也未与生成式骨干做受控的规模对齐比较。

3cd27c5a0d494cc4c281cc9d4bafecf942dfeb18.title: Social Humanoid: Socially Responsive Human-Humanoid Interaction
3cd27c5a0d494cc4c281cc9d4bafecf942dfeb18.comment: CoRL 2026, Project page: this https URL
3cd27c5a0d494cc4c281cc9d4bafecf942dfeb18.summary: Humanoid robots are typically trained as solitary agents, leaving them unable to coordinate physically with human partners who naturally anticipate and adjust to one another. To bridge this gap, we present Social Humanoid, a hierarchical system that generates and executes socially responsive whole-body motion on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 conditioned on a human partner's motion. Its high-level policy performs flexible sequence modeling of human and humanoid motion through a shared tokenized representation, generating reactive humanoid motion and anticipating the partner's motion when they are occluded, while a low-level whole-body tracking controller executes the generated motion on the robot. To train the system, we introduce a two-phase adaptive retargeting procedure that retargets one interaction partner to the robot while morphing the other partner to preserve contact dynamics, reachability, and relative body scale. We apply this procedure across five motion-capture datasets to produce a new Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHI) benchmark of 260 hours of human-humanoid interactions. Our results demonstrate that Social Humanoid produces coordinated, human-aligned behavior across diverse interaction types in simulation and the real world. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 类人机器人通常作为孤立个体训练，难以与人类伙伴进行身体协同。Social Humanoid 用共享 token 化表示建模人与机器人的运动序列，生成反应式全身动作并由低层控制器在 29-DoF Unitree G1 上执行，作者报告在仿真与真实世界中产生协调、与人类对齐的行为。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，类人机器人通常被训练为孤立个体（solitary agents），因此无法与自然会相互预判和调整的人类伙伴进行身体层面的协同。这一"人-人协同能力"的缺失是本文的直接动因。
AI.method: 输入是人类伙伴的运动，系统为层级结构：高层策略通过共享 token 化表示对人与类人机器人运动做灵活的序列建模，输出反应式类人动作，并在伙伴被遮挡时预测其动作；低层全身跟踪控制器把生成的动作在 29-DoF Unitree G1 上执行。训练数据来自两阶段自适应重定向流程：将一个交互伙伴重定向到机器人，同时形变另一个伙伴以保留接触动力学、可达性与相对身体尺度。相对"孤立智能体"的常规训练方式，改变之处在于把伙伴运动作为条件、并显式建模遮挡下的伙伴动作预测。该流程应用于五个动作捕捉数据集，产出 260 小时的 Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHI) 基准。

0474304f7bc1d69c319e0692e9e310b509335c8f.title: OopsieRecover: Learning Transferable VLA Corrections from Semantic Interventions
0474304f7bc1d69c319e0692e9e310b509335c8f.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can perform a wide range of robotic manipulation tasks, but often fail during deployment. Teaching them to recover from these failures requires substantial corrective data: existing approaches learn to recover from failures by directly associating corrective actions with the observations in which they were demonstrated. For instance, DAgger-like fine-tuning can require tens to hundreds of interactions, yet the resulting policy may still fail to generalize the learned corrections beyond the demonstrated scenarios. We hypothesize that semantics can capture the underlying reasons for failures and their corrections, enabling policies to learn from only a handful of corrective demonstrations and generalize those corrections to novel objects, and scene variations. We propose OopsieRecover, a framework that uses abduction to infer the intent behind a small set of corrective demonstrations and encodes the inferred knowledge as dense spatial representations and conditional costs. These costs capture when a behavior is undesirable and steer the policy toward more desirable action regions. We experiment across 6 tasks and variations in object poses, scenes, and related tasks, and find that only a handful of corrective demonstrations can enable a VLA to overcome failures across a broad range of novel situations, without requiring new corrective data for each variation. Please refer to this https URL for videos.

AI.tldr: 针对 VLA 部署失败需大量纠正数据且纠正难以泛化的问题，作者提出 OopsieRecover：用溯因推理从少量纠正演示中推断失败与纠正的语义原因，并编码为稠密空间表示与条件代价来引导策略。作者在 6 个任务及物体位姿、场景、相关任务变化中报告：少量纠正演示即可让 VLA 在多种新情境下克服失败，无需为每种变化重新采集纠正数据；摘要未给出数值指标。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型能完成多种机器人操作任务，但在部署中常失败。现有失败恢复方法把纠正动作直接与演示时的观测关联，需要大量纠正数据（摘要称 DAgger 类微调可能需要数十到数百次交互），且学到的纠正仍可能无法泛化到演示场景之外。
AI.method: 输入是一小组失败场景下的纠正演示（观测—纠正动作）以及待部署的 VLA 策略；方法对这些演示做溯因（abduction），推断出失败背后的意图/原因性解释，再把解释编码成两类产物：稠密空间表示与条件代价。条件代价用于标记"行为不可接受"的区域，并在动作产生时把策略引向更可取的动作区域。相对被比较的 DAgger 类直接观测—动作关联微调，其改变在于不把纠正当作逐观测的模仿目标，而是当作可迁移的语义约束，因此同一份代价可用于新物体、新场景。摘要未说明代价具体如何嵌入 VLA 的动作生成或训练环节，也未说明稠密表示的构造细节。
AI.result: 摘要在 6 个任务及物体位姿、场景、相关任务变化上做了实验，但未报告任何数值指标、成功率或对比表格，仅以定性方式声称少量纠正演示即可让 VLA 在多种新情境下克服失败，且无需为每种变化新增纠正数据。这是作者主张，未经独立验证；是否为仿真或真机实验摘要未说明。
AI.conclusion: 若该主张成立，其意义在于把纠正数据从"逐场景的模仿样本"变为"可复用的语义约束"，从而降低 VLA 部署后修复失败的数据成本，属于数据与效率层面的贡献。但当前证据仅为摘要中的定性表述，缺少数值指标、基线对比与仿真/真机条件说明，读者不应据此推断其泛化幅度或优于 DAgger 类方法的程度。
AI.core_method: 用溯因从少量纠正演示推出失败原因，转成稠密空间表示与条件代价，在动作选择时把策略推向可取动作区域。

key_results.finding: 作者对现有做法的代价描述：DAgger 类微调可能需要数十到数百次交互，且所得策略可能仍无法把学到的纠正泛化到演示场景之外。
key_results.setting: 对现有失败恢复方法的定性比较陈述，非本文实测对照；未给出具体任务或指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: For instance, DAgger-like fine-tuning can require tens to hundreds of interactions, yet the resulting policy may still fail to generalize the learned corrections beyond the demonstrated scenarios.

limitations: 摘要未报告任何定量结果：没有成功率、提升幅度、交互次数或与基线的数值对比，因此无法判断相对改进幅度。
摘要未说明"少量"纠正演示的具体数量，也未说明实验是仿真还是真机、任务规模与失败类型覆盖范围。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

af1a651b7b8b6d524d6f17b91e21662bd723036b.title: Efficient Diffusion Policy Fine Tuning with Latent Noise Representation Bridging
af1a651b7b8b6d524d6f17b91e21662bd723036b.comment: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2026
af1a651b7b8b6d524d6f17b91e21662bd723036b.summary: Pre-trained diffusion and flow policies have emerged as powerful backbones for robotics, yet adapting them to novel data via reinforcement learning (RL) remains computationally expensive, sample inefficient and lacks theoretical guarantees. Prior approaches that fine-tune the initial noise bypass costly backpropagation through time but struggle with the "noise aliasing" problem: there does not exista natural link between the noise space value and the action space value. This paper resolves these challenges by introducing the Latent Noise Linear Markov Decision Process (LNL-MDP). We derive the Bridge Equation for LNL-MDPs which eliminates the noise aliasing problem by aligning values with a shared representation between the noise and the action space. Furthermore, our LNL-MDP fine tuning framework falls under the FineTuneRL theory with near-optimal guarantee. Leveraging these insights, we propose Latent Representation Bridging for Diffusion (LARBRID), an algorithm that efficiently learns the representation to optimize the initial distribution that steers the pre-trained model to act optimally in the environment. It yields up to 2-3$\times$ performance increases on challenging control problems across a diverse suite of robotic locomotion and manipulation tasks. Code can be found at: this http URL .

AI.tldr: 预训练扩散/流策略用RL适配新数据计算昂贵、样本效率低且缺理论保证，而只微调初始噪声的方法受"noise aliasing"困扰。本文提出LNL-MDP与Bridge Equation，在噪声与动作空间间建立共享表示，并据此给出LARBRID来优化引导预训练模型的初始分布；作者报告在机器人locomotion与manipulation任务上性能最高提升2-3×。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出：预训练扩散与流策略已成为机器人强大的backbone，但通过RL将其适配到新数据仍然computationally expensive、sample inefficient且lacks theoretical guarantees。先前微调初始噪声的做法虽避开了昂贵的backpropagation through time，却受"noise aliasing"限制——噪声空间取值与动作空间取值之间不存在自然联系。
AI.method: 输入是预训练扩散/流策略、环境交互数据与RL优化目标；方法把初始噪声的微调形式化为Latent Noise Linear Markov Decision Process（LNL-MDP）。机制上推导Bridge Equation，通过在噪声空间与动作空间之间共享同一表示来对齐价值，从而消除noise aliasing。相对只调初始噪声的先前做法，LARBRID改为高效学习该共享潜表示，并用它优化初始分布，使预训练模型在环境中作出最优动作；输出是被微调后的策略（其初始噪声分布）。摘要还称该微调框架属于FineTuneRL理论，具有near-optimal guarantee，但未给出该保证的形式化条件或界。
AI.result: 作者报告：在多样化机器人locomotion与manipulation控制任务上，性能最高提升2-3×。摘要未报告具体基准名称、比较基线的具体身份与数值、评测指标单位，也未说明该结果是仿真还是真机。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：把扩散/流策略的RL微调重写成噪声空间的线性MDP，并用共享潜表示连接噪声值与动作值，为"如何在不反传整条扩散链的前提下改进预训练策略"提供了一种机制化路径，且声称带有near-optimal理论保证。但证据边界很窄：可核对的只有作者自述的最多2-3×相对性能提升，缺少具体任务、绝对指标、基线与仿真/真机设定；理论保证本身在摘要中仅为声明，未给出假设或界。
AI.core_method: 把初始噪声的RL微调建模为线性MDP，学习噪声与动作空间共享的潜表示以消除noise aliasing，并用该表示优化初始分布来引导预训练策略。

key_results.finding: 在多样化机器人locomotion与manipulation控制任务上，性能最高提升2-3×（相对基线；基线具体名称摘要未报告）。
key_results.setting: 任务：多样化的挑战性控制问题，覆盖机器人locomotion与manipulation；比较对象、基准名称、评测指标及单位、仿真或真机条件：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: It yields up to 2-3$\times$ performance increases on challenging control problems across a diverse suite of robotic locomotion and manipulation tasks.

limitations: 摘要未报告作者自述的局限（no author-reported limitation stated in the abstract）。
摘要未报告：具体任务/基准名称、基线身份、除2-3×外的任何数值指标、评测指标单位。
摘要未报告：结果是仿真还是真机、硬件平台、延迟或样本效率的具体数值；'near-optimal guarantee'仅为声明，未给出形式化条件与界的细节。

055bb5f74706cd02e3b4eb265ec2ae8541a51350.title: VREgo: Consumer VR Headsets for Learning Robot Manipulation from Egocentric Demonstrations
055bb5f74706cd02e3b4eb265ec2ae8541a51350.summary: VREgo trains manipulation policies from demonstrations recorded on consumer VR headsets; we instantiate it with EgoKit on one such headset, the PICO 4 Ultra. On-device head and hand tracking and stereo object localisation allow the operator to begin a demonstration at the table. We adapt HumanEgo's preprocessing to estimate grasp thresholds per recording, update object positions after release, and propagate segmentation masks between keyframes. We evaluate policies in simulation on two tabletop tasks recorded by one operator. For cube placement, we compare PICO and Project Aria recordings of the same 41 layouts. With 40 training demonstrations, the PICO policies placed the cube on the tray in 67, 74, and 60 of 100 evaluation layouts across three training seeds. The corresponding Aria results were 73, 78, and 0. For a two-stage stacking task recorded with the PICO alone, the baseline placed the block on the tray in 94 of 100 layouts and met the end-of-episode criterion for both placements in two. In one diagnostic episode, repeated replanning deferred release beyond the eight executed steps. Demonstration replays also showed that the open gripper could displace the cube before grasping it. After adapting the training trajectories and adding task-specific execution rules that use simulator object positions, the system met both placement criteria in 93.8% of episodes across four evaluation noise seeds. The same 100 layouts informed rule development and evaluation. VREgo is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: VREgo 用消费级 VR 头显（PICO 4 Ultra 上的 EgoKit）采集第一视角演示来训练桌面操作策略，并在仿真中评测。同 41 个布局下，PICO 三次种子把方块放到托盘的为 67/74/60（共 100 个评测布局），对应 Aria 为 73/78/0；加入使用仿真器物体位置的任务规则后，两阶段堆叠任务的"双放置准则"达成率为 93.8%。
AI.motivation: 摘要主张消费级 VR 头显可用于采集机器人操作演示：头眼手追踪与立体物体定位让操作者在桌边即可开始演示，无需先搭建别处的采集流程。摘要未报告现有采集方式的具体失败点或定量动机（这部分信息缺失）。
AI.method: 输入是操作者佩戴消费级 VR 头显录制的第一视角演示，依赖设备端头部与手部追踪及立体物体定位。相对所述基线 HumanEgo 的预处理，作者做三处改动：按每条录制估计抓取阈值、在释放后更新物体位置、在关键帧之间传播分割掩码，由此得到可训练的操作策略。后续还改动了训练轨迹，并加入使用仿真器物体位置的任务特定执行规则，输出为仿真环境中执行的两阶段放置行为。
AI.result: 作者报告：在仿真、由一名操作者录制、同样 41 个布局的条件下，用 40 条训练演示，PICO 录制的策略三次训练种子分别在 100 个评测布局中 67、74、60 次把方块放到托盘，Project Aria 录制对应为 73、78、0。两阶段堆叠任务（仅 PICO 录制）基线在 100 个布局中 94 次把块放到托盘，但两次放置准则同时满足仅 2 次。诊断显示重复重规划把释放推迟到 8 个执行步之后，且演示回放显示张开的手爪可能在抓取前推动方块；调整训练轨迹并加入使用仿真器物体位置的任务规则后，四个评测噪声种子下 93.8% 的回合满足两项放置准则。所有数字均为作者报告，未经独立验证；摘要未报告真机结果与统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究者的意义在于：第一视角演示的采集端可以从专用设备下沉到消费级 VR 头显，且 PICO 与 Aria 在三次种子中的多数结果处于同一量级；但摘要同时显示 Aria 有一次种子为 0 次成功，说明结果对训练种子较敏感。证据仅限于仿真中的两个桌面任务、单一操作者，以及"规则开发与评估共用同一批 100 个布局"，因此不能据此推断真机部署能力或跨操作者的泛化。
AI.core_method: 用消费级 VR 头显录制第一视角演示，经改动的 HumanEgo 预处理（逐条录制估计抓取阈值、释放后更新物体位置、关键帧间传播掩码）训练操作策略，再叠加使用仿真器物体位置的任务执行规则。

key_results.finding: 在调整训练轨迹并加入使用仿真器物体位置的任务特定执行规则后，系统在四个评测噪声种子下，93.8% 的回合同时满足两项放置准则。
key_results.setting: 同一两阶段堆叠任务，仿真环境，四个评测噪声种子；作者说明规则开发与评估使用同一批 100 个布局。
key_results.evidence_quote: After adapting the training trajectories and adding task-specific execution rules that use simulator object positions, the system met both placement criteria in 93.8% of episodes across four evaluation noise seeds.

limitations: 作者报告的性质限制：评测全部在仿真中进行，摘要未报告真机实验；演示由一名操作者采集。二者均属摘要明示或明确缺失的信息。
作者报告的数据划分限制：摘要称"The same 100 layouts informed rule development and evaluation"，即任务规则的开发与评估共用同一批布局，摘要未报告独立的留出评测集。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

5aa16a6b0efb50e2f8bdaa11ed8b91425e566cff.title: GuidedWAM: Training-Free Energy Guidance for World Action Models in Autonomous Driving
5aa16a6b0efb50e2f8bdaa11ed8b91425e566cff.summary: World action models (WAMs) for autonomous driving couple the driving policy and the visual world model in a single generative network whose objectives are fixed post-training. Conditioning on a new driving objective requires retraining. We study energy guidance as a general mechanism and present GuidedWAM, a model-agnostic framework for injecting driving objectives into frozen WAMs at sampling time. Our framework constructs each objective as differentiable energies on the sampler's intermediate clean-action estimate, which needs only forward access to the frozen model, and is stabilized by sampling-time guidance scheduling, per-energy normalization, and velocity-bounded correction. On the NAVSIM v2 hard-split, guidance improves all three frozen, publicly released WAMs by 1.8 to 3.6 EPDMS, averaged over three sampler seeds, and adds less than 10% to the sampling time per step. These results position energy guidance as a practical post-training control channel for WAMs.

AI.tldr: 冻结的世界动作模型（WAM）无法在不重训的情况下接受新驾驶目标；GuidedWAM 在采样阶段用可微能量引导把目标注入冻结模型，在 NAVSIM v2 hard-split 上使三个公开 WAM 提升 1.8–3.6 EPDMS，采样时间每步增加不到 10%。
AI.motivation: WAM 把驾驶策略与视觉世界模型耦合在单一生成网络中，其优化目标在训练后即固定，若要条件化到新的驾驶目标就必须重新训练。作者据此提出把“能量引导”当作一种通用机制，作为训练后控制通道来避免重训。
AI.method: 输入：一个已冻结的 WAM 采样过程，以及被表达为可微能量的驾驶目标。机制：在采样器的“中间干净动作估计”上定义目标能量，仅通过前向访问冻结模型来计算引导，不更新任何权重。为稳定引导，作者加入采样阶段的引导调度（guidance scheduling）、逐能量归一化（per-energy normalization）与速度有界校正（velocity-bounded correction）。输出：沿采样轨迹被修正后的动作/轨迹，即带有新驾驶目标的生成结果。相对基线（原始冻结 WAM、无引导）改变的是采样时的条件注入方式，而非模型参数。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 NAVSIM v2 hard-split 上，引导使全部三个冻结且公开释放的 WAM 提升 1.8 至 3.6 EPDMS（三个采样器种子的平均），并且每步采样时间增加不到 10%。摘要未给出与任何引导外基线的逐项对比数值，也未说明该评测是仿真还是实车条件。
AI.conclusion: 摘要支持的理解是：对耦合策略与世界模型的生成式驾驶模型，采样期能量引导可作为免训练的后处理控制通道，在同一冻结模型上跨三个公开模型获得一致的正向 EPDMS 增益，且采样开销有限。证据边界：仅单一 benchmark（NAVSIM v2 hard-split）与摘要所报指标，未报告实车验证、逐目标分解、失败案例或统计显著性；作者称其为“实用的后训练控制通道”，但摘要未报告数值层面的 SOTA 比较。
AI.core_method: 在冻结 WAM 的采样过程中，对中间干净动作估计施加可微能量并配合引导调度、能量归一化与速度有界校正，从而无需重训即注入新驾驶目标。

key_results.finding: 每步采样时间增加不到 10%。
key_results.setting: NAVSIM v2 hard-split 评测流程中的采样步骤；对照为未引导采样；指标为每步采样时间增量；摘要未报告绝对耗时数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: and adds less than 10% to the sampling time per step

limitations: 摘要未报告：与训练式/微调式适配方法的直接数值对比，因此无法判断相对重训路线的优劣。
摘要未报告：硬件、绝对采样耗时、能量项的具体组成与各消融（引导调度、归一化、速度有界校正的分别贡献与失败情形）。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

288a2927c74267f2130c6cb28bab4e345af0dce7.title: Embodied RAG++: Retrieval-Augmented Generation From What Exists to What Works in Embodied Scenes
288a2927c74267f2130c6cb28bab4e345af0dce7.summary: To serve a request in a human environment, a robot system must find an object that satisfies a functional requirement and a robot that can feasibly reach it. Scene graphs record which objects exist and where, but they often omit capabilities documented only in product manuals. Retrieval-augmented generation methods can read such manuals, yet they rarely reason jointly over object capabilities, physical instances, robot states, and dynamic connectivity. We introduce E2W-Bench, the Exists-to-Works Benchmark, which links dynamic hybrid scene graphs with real product manuals to evaluate capability-grounded robot--object assignment under availability, mobility, vertical-reach, and connector constraints. We also present Embodied RAG++, a spatially grounded retrieval framework that scopes retrieval to the manuals linked to candidate objects, caches extracted capabilities per product model, and resolves robot--object feasibility through deterministic spatial reasoning. On E2W-Bench, Embodied RAG++ reaches a pair accuracy of 0.90 with Qwen2.5-32B and 1.00 with Llama3.3-70B, compared with at most 0.30 and 0.55 for the baselines, while requiring the shortest preprocessing time among the retrieval-based methods and tying for the lowest total token count.

AI.tldr: 论文面向机器人服务请求中的“找到能满足功能要求且机器人可达的物体-机器人配对”问题，提出 E2W-Bench 基准与 Embodied RAG++ 空间接地检索框架；作者报告在 E2W-Bench 上配对准确率为 0.90（Qwen2.5-32B）和 1.00（Llama3.3-70B），高于基线至多 0.30 和 0.55。
AI.motivation: 场景图能记录物体是否存在及位置，但常缺少仅记录在产品手册中的能力信息；RAG 方法可读取手册，却很少联合推理物体能力、物理实例、机器人状态与动态连通性。
AI.method: 输入是服务请求、动态混合场景图及与候选物体关联的真实产品手册。Embodied RAG++ 将检索范围限定到候选物体所链接的手册，按产品型号缓存抽取出的能力，再用确定性空间推理判断机器人-物体是否可行，输出满足功能要求且可达的机器人-物体配对。相对所述基线，变化在于把检索与空间可行性判定结合，而非只做手册问答或只依赖场景图。

0ebcb72786cb9ad2944cdeeebe43b78968f66efb.title: PhySA: Decoupling Aesthetic and Physical Rewards for Humanoid Locomotion
0ebcb72786cb9ad2944cdeeebe43b78968f66efb.comment: 24 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on R2RL: Roadmap to Sample-Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
0ebcb72786cb9ad2944cdeeebe43b78968f66efb.summary: Humanoid locomotion policies trained without an explicit smoothness objective tend to produce jerky, high-energy gaits that stress actuators. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer an appealing reward source: given a rendered rollout, a VLM returns an aesthetic quality score on [0,10] without task-specific feature engineering. We find, however, that aesthetic preference and physical smoothness point in opposite directions: across four production VLMs, clips with higher joint acceleration receive higher aesthetic scores (mean Pearson r=+0.66). We study PhySA (Physical Smoothness and Aesthetics), which keeps the two on separate, independently removable reward channels: a sparse, asynchronous VLM score and a phase-triggered correction channel that adjusts physical penalty weights from simulator state. Ablations attribute the smoothness gain to the correction channel. On MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 at 2.6M steps, PhySA lowers joint acceleration by 26 to 32% relative to vanilla PPO, Text2Reward, and Eureka (three seeds), at the cost of shorter episodes. In a single extended run it lowers joint acceleration by 59.5% relative to Prompt2Policy, while a three-seed replication shows a smaller, non-significant reduction (7.2%). The gain does not transfer to IsaacLab or the Unitree G1, even after rescaling the smoothness term.

AI.tldr: 无显式平滑目标的仿人运动策略步态抖动、能耗高；作者发现 VLM 的美学评分与物理平滑度方向相反（四个 VLM 上关节加速度越高评分越高，平均 Pearson r=+0.66），因此提出 PhySA，把 VLM 审美奖励与物理平滑修正放在两条可独立移除的通道上。MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 上关节加速度相对 vanilla PPO、Text2Reward、Eureka 降低 26–32%，但增益未迁移到 IsaacLab 与 Unitree G1。
AI.motivation: 缺少显式平滑目标的仿人运动策略会产生抖动、高能耗、给执行器带来压力的步态。VLM 看似可提供无需任务特定特征工程的奖励来源，但摘要指出审美偏好与物理平滑度方向相反，直接使用美学评分并不等价于获得物理平滑。
AI.method: 输入是渲染出的 rollout（用于 VLM 评分）与仿真器状态。PhySA 把两类奖励解耦为相互独立、可分别移除的通道：一条稀疏、异步的 VLM 美学分数通道；一条由相位触发、依据仿真器状态调整物理惩罚权重的修正通道。消融显示平滑度提升归因于修正通道。输出是训练后的仿人运动策略，其步行平滑度（以关节加速度衡量）更高。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo Humanoid-v5、2.6M 步、三个随机种子下，关节加速度相对 vanilla PPO、Text2Reward、Eureka 降低 26–32%，代价是回合更短。单次延长训练中相对 Prompt2Policy 降低 59.5%，而三个种子复现只得到更小且不显著的 7.2% 降幅。增益未迁移到 IsaacLab 或 Unitree G1，即便重新缩放平滑项后也一样。摘要未报告绝对加速度数值、奖励值、成功率或计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提示：在具身策略中使用 VLM 美学奖励时，审美与物理平滑可能是互相冲突的目标，需要显式解耦而非直接优化美学分数。证据边界明确：平滑增益主要来自相位触发的物理修正通道，在 MuJoCo 上相对若干基线成立，但在单次延长运行的 59.5% 与三种子复现的 7.2%（不显著）之间差异大，且摘要报告跨仿真器与真实机器人平台（Unitree G1）迁移失败，因此结论不宜外推为通用的平滑运动方案。
AI.core_method: 把稀疏异步的 VLM 美学评分与相位触发、由仿真状态调节物理惩罚权重的修正项拆成两条可独立移除的奖励通道。

key_results.setting: 四个生产级 VLM；样本为渲染后的运动片段；指标为美学分数与关节加速度之间的 Pearson 相关系数。摘要未报告 VLM 具体名称、片段数量与任务设置。

dd3f4456ae261163ef9ee1f408c2482af12328d1.title: Adaptive Hybrid Force-Vision Control with EMG-Derived References for Deformable Bottle Manipulation
dd3f4456ae261163ef9ee1f408c2482af12328d1.summary: Robotic automation of laboratory tasks has become a growing interest to remove researchers from hazardous environments and repetitive procedures. However, even equipment as simple as squeeze bottles poses a challenging manipulation problem due to its deformability. This paper presents an adaptive hybrid vision-force controller for robotic grippers to effectively manipulate laboratory squeeze bottles to dispense liquid. This approach integrates force and vision feedback according to the interaction state, enabling effective squeezing while accounting for bottle deformation and recovery. The proposed controller is validated by comparing its performance with a pure force controller on 12 combinations of conditions consisting of 2 target dispense volumes, 2 plastic squeeze bottles, and 1 to 3 squeezes used to dispense. Human demonstrations of these operating conditions were collected using electromyography (EMG) sensing mapped to a desired grip force, which was then used as the force reference for the controllers to squeeze the bottles. Results demonstrated that the proposed adaptive hybrid vision-force controller achieved more accurate liquid dispensing with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 6.54 mL compared to a MAE of 15.92 mL from the pure force controller, while also replicating the human action recorded from the EMG signal more closely.

AI.tldr: 针对可变形挤压瓶倒液这一难点操作，作者提出按交互状态融合力反馈与视觉反馈的自适应混合控制器，并用EMG人体演示映射出的期望握力作为力参考；在12种条件组合下倒液MAE为6.54 mL，而纯力控制器为15.92 mL。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，实验室任务的机器人自动化旨在让研究者脱离危险环境与重复流程，但即便是挤压瓶这类简单器材，也因瓶体可变形而构成困难的操控问题；纯力控制未按交互状态利用视觉信息。
AI.method: 输入是机器人夹爪的力反馈与视觉反馈，以及由EMG人体演示映射得到的期望握力参考。控制器依据当前交互状态整合力与视觉信息，以应对瓶体变形与回弹，输出挤压动作使瓶子按目标体积出液。相较纯力控制器基线，变化在于引入视觉反馈与随交互状态调整的融合策略，并把EMG示教得到的握力设为力参考。
AI.result: 作者在2种目标出液体积、2种塑料挤压瓶、1至3次挤压构成的12种条件组合上，将所提控制器与纯力控制器对比：所提方法倒液的平均绝对误差（MAE）为6.54 mL，纯力控制器为15.92 mL，且更贴近EMG信号记录的人体动作。摘要未报告统计显著性、重复次数、机器人平台或真实/仿真环境。
AI.conclusion: 对可变形容器倒液这类形变与接触耦合的任务，按交互状态融合视觉与力反馈可提升定量出液精度，并具备复现人体示教力曲线的潜力；但证据仅限摘要所述的12种条件组合，且未说明硬件平台与统计细节，不能据此推断其他任务、容器或真实部署条件下的表现。
AI.core_method: 按交互状态在力反馈与视觉反馈之间自适应整合，并以EMG人体演示映射的握力作为力参考来驱动夹爪挤压瓶子。

key_results.finding: 自适应混合视觉-力控制器的倒液平均绝对误差为6.54 mL，优于纯力控制器的15.92 mL。
key_results.setting: 任务：机器人夹爪操作实验室挤压瓶出液；条件：2种目标出液体积、2种塑料挤压瓶、1至3次挤压共12种组合；基线：纯力控制器；平台与统计细节：摘要未报告。

key_results.finding: 作者报告该方法比纯力控制器更贴近EMG信号所记录的人体动作（摘要未给出量化指标）。
key_results.setting: 任务：以EMG人体演示映射的期望握力作为力参考的倒液挤压；基线：纯力控制器；具体度量与数值：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: while also replicating the human action recorded from the EMG signal more closely.

limitations: 作者在摘要中未自述任何局限（摘要未报告）。
实验平台、机器人/夹爪硬件、液体或瓶内物、以及是否在真实环境或仿真中验证：摘要未报告。

e630222604c806317d623725d45eec6097b1146d.title: Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy
e630222604c806317d623725d45eec6097b1146d.comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, accepted for publication in ICARCV 2026
e630222604c806317d623725d45eec6097b1146d.summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.

AI.tldr: 固定速率运行的开放词汇检测会把嵌入式算力浪费在低价值帧上；作者提出一种用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度在 Jetson Orin Nano 上切换低/中/高三档 YOLO-World-S 模式的能量感知调度器。40 次真实导航试验中任务成功 8/10（各固定速率基线为 7/10），相对 8 Hz 高频率基线的平均 Jetson 输入功率降低 5.2%、实际 OVD 调用率降低 34.0%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出开放词汇检测允许机器人在运行时搜索目标查询，但固定速率推理会在空闲运动、地图重访或视角稳定期间把嵌入式算力花在低价值帧上。
AI.method: 输入是机器人状态与感知信号：里程计、地图变化、检测器置信度；调度器据此在低、中、高三档功耗的 YOLO-World-S 模式之间切换，运行于 Jetson Orin Nano。相对被比较的固定速率推理基线，改变的是"何时以多大算力做检测"，输出是自适应的检测调用节奏与相应功耗水平。
AI.result: 在 AgileX LIMO 上以 40 次真实导航试验评测能量—质量权衡（两个目标物体、每个目标—策略对五种摆放、四种感知策略）：在瓶子和杯子试验中调度器取得 8/10 任务成功，各固定速率基线为 7/10；相对 8 Hz 高频率基线平均 Jetson 输入功率降低 5.2%（相对百分比），实际 OVD 调用率降低 34.0%。另有 60 s 静止微基准：相对 8 Hz 基线平均功率由 8.045 W 降至 7.301 W，能量由 484.7 J 降至 438.1 J。作者同时报告该方法并不最小化任务窗口的 Jetson 输入能量。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：把检测调度与机器人自身状态耦合，可作为低功耗自主性的一种功耗管理机制，并保持有竞争力的任务可靠性。证据边界是单一平台上的 40 次真实导航试验加一个 60 s 静止微基准；摘要明确说明任务窗口能量指标需结合任务进度与运行时间解读，因此不能把瞬时功率节省等同于端到端能耗节省。
AI.core_method: 用里程计、地图变化和检测器置信度在线判断帧的价值，从而在低/中/高三档 YOLO-World-S 推理模式间切换。

key_results.finding: 在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器任务成功 8/10，各固定速率基线为 7/10；相对 8 Hz 高频率基线平均 Jetson 输入功率降低 5.2%，实际 OVD 调用率降低 34.0%。
key_results.setting: AgileX LIMO 上的 40 次真实导航试验，两个目标物体、每个目标—策略对五种摆放、四种感知策略；基线为固定速率推理（含 8 Hz 高频率基线）。
key_results.evidence_quote: Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%.

key_results.finding: 作者报告该方法不最小化任务窗口的 Jetson 输入能量，因为更长的任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。
key_results.setting: 摘要未报告该结论所对应的具体任务时长、对照条件或统计检验。
key_results.evidence_quote: It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings.

limitations: 作者报告的限制：不最小化任务窗口的 Jetson 输入能量，较长任务可能抵消瞬时功率节省。
摘要未报告：除 8 Hz 高频率基线外其他固定速率基线的具体频率、成功率与功率/调用率差异的统计显著性或置信区间。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

55d4034008cb78aadaa691a45cf4429573f0e21a.title: Closed-Loop Physics-Based Manipulation Evaluation at a Commodity Price: What 4.4 L4 GPU hours at $3.50 Buys You
55d4034008cb78aadaa691a45cf4429573f0e21a.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to IROS 2026 Workshop on Building Scalable Infrastructure for Robot Learning: From Data Scaling to Real-World Deployment
55d4034008cb78aadaa691a45cf4429573f0e21a.summary: Running evaluations of contact-rich robotic manipulation at statistical scale has largely been possible only at well-resourced labs, highlighting the need for affordable and efficient options for broader audiences. We present a reproducible evaluation harness wrapper based on a previous study at 200-rollout scale on serverless commodity GPUs, at a cost of approximately $3.50 USD and 38 minutes of wall-clock per replication (4.4 L4-GPU-hours across eight parallel shards). Using the harness, we report a partially controlled negative result on action chunking with sparse data: three independently trained chunked checkpoints produce zero genuine successes across 780 rollouts, while three single-step checkpoints range from 2.6% to 11.8% success rate. A per-step-replanning control partially isolates chunk prediction, rather than open-loop chunk execution as the mechanism, with the failure localized to the training formulation and multi-step prediction. This work further democratizes physics-based policy development and evaluation through our reusable harness.

AI.tldr: 针对接触丰富机器人操作难以在统计规模上低成本评测的问题，作者提出基于无服务器商用 GPU 的可复现评测封装：每次复现约 3.50 美元、38 分钟墙上时间，消耗 4.4 L4-GPU 小时（跨 8 个并行分片）。作者同时报告稀疏数据下 action chunking 的负面结果：3 个独立训练的 chunked checkpoint 在 780 次 rollout 中零真实成功，而 3 个 single-step checkpoint 成功率为 2.6%–11.8%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，运行统计规模的接触丰富机器人操作评测此前基本只有资源充足实验室才能做到，因此需要面向更广泛受众的廉价高效方案。作者由此把既有 200-rollout 规模评测封装成可复用的商品 GPU 评测 harness，并借此考察稀疏数据下的 action chunking。
AI.method: 评测对象是已训练的策略 checkpoint：3 个独立训练的 chunked checkpoint 与 3 个 single-step checkpoint。方法本身不是学习新策略，而是把基于先前 200-rollout 规模研究的闭环物理操作评测流程封装成可复现 harness，在无服务器商用 GPU 上跨 8 个并行分片运行。作者还加入 per-step-replanning 对照，用来区分 failure 来自多步 chunk 预测，还是来自开环 chunk 执行。输出包括每次复现的成本与墙上时间、GPU 小时，以及不同 checkpoint 的成功率与机制归因；训练与任务环境细节摘要未展开。
AI.result: 作者报告：基于先前 200-rollout 规模研究的可复现评测封装，在无服务器商用 GPU 上每次复现约 3.50 美元、38 分钟墙上时间，消耗 4.4 L4-GPU 小时（跨 8 个并行分片）。在稀疏数据 action chunking 的部分控制负面结果中，3 个独立训练的 chunked checkpoint 在 780 次 rollout 中零真实成功，而 3 个 single-step checkpoint 成功率为 2.6% 到 11.8%。逐步重规划对照将机制部分归因于 chunk 预测而非开环 chunk 执行，并把失败定位到训练公式与多步预测。以上均为作者报告，摘要未报告统计显著性或独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，这项工作主要降低的是闭环物理操作策略开发与评测的算力/成本门槛，并给出一个稀疏数据下 action chunking 可能失败的受控线索：问题可能出在多步预测与训练公式，而不只是开环执行。证据边界是：摘要未报告评测任务/基准、机器人平台、仿真或真实机器人、数据规模与统计显著性，因此不能外推到更广泛任务或真实部署。
AI.core_method: 把既有 200-rollout 闭环物理操作评测封装成可在无服务器商用 GPU 上 8 分片并行运行的 harness，并用逐步重规划对照区分多步 chunk 预测与开环执行。

key_results.setting: 作为部分控制的负面结果分析；摘要未报告定量指标、消融细节或统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: A per-step-replanning control partially isolates chunk prediction, rather than open-loop chunk execution as the mechanism, with the failure localized to the training formulation and multi-step prediction.

limitations: 作者报告的负面结果：在稀疏数据下，3 个独立训练的 action-chunking checkpoint 在 780 次 rollout 中零真实成功，作者将其失败定位到训练公式与多步预测，而非开环 chunk 执行。
摘要未报告：评测任务/基准名称、机器人平台、训练数据规模、仿真还是真实机器人、随机种子与统计显著性。
