97e225755a1f66b73e1fdab07d4bf3de72fafddd.title: AffordJEV: Affordance Grounding by Confirming Candidate Regions
97e225755a1f66b73e1fdab07d4bf3de72fafddd.summary: Affordance grounding asks which visible part of an object performs a requested operation, a basic capability for embodied manipulation and human--robot interaction. Most existing methods follow a System Two paradigm: a multimodal language model first writes a chain of thought and then turns its conclusion into a box or points for a segmenter. This incurs considerable inference cost, gives the semantic decision little direct control over the extent of the final region, and makes mistakes hard to correct. Yet locating an affordance is essentially a perceptual judgment that need not be argued out in words. We therefore propose, in which frozen segmenters propose candidate regions and a System One model decides directly which of them perform the operation, generating no text and reading each decision from a single forward pass. Our contributions are twofold. (1) An inference framework that confirms candidate regions level by level, from object to part to sub-part, with evidence passed between the levels in both directions so that the levels correct one another. (2) A System One model trained for this framework: existing System One models are built for general-purpose decisions, judge one candidate per request and are ill-suited to the framework's region questions, so ours learns directly from the requests the framework itself produces and judges all candidates of a level at once. Trained only on InstructPart and evaluated with definition-aligned operation words, outperforms chain-of-thought methods in domain and in zero-shot transfer to UMD and IIT-AFF, is better overall than existing System One models run in the same framework, and needs fewer judge requests. To our knowledge, is the first approach to bring System One models to affordance grounding.

AI.tldr: 针对 affordance grounding 的 System Two 范式（多模态模型先写思维链、再把结论变成框或点交给分割器）推理开销大、语义决策难以控制最终区域范围、错误难纠正的问题，作者提出让冻结分割器提出候选区域、由 System One 模型单次前向直接判定哪些区域执行所请求操作，并按 物体→部件→子部件 逐层确认候选、层间双向传递证据。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多为 System Two 范式：多模态语言模型先写出思维链，再把结论转成框或点交给分割器。摘要指出这带来三点代价：推理开销相当大、语义决策对最终区域范围缺乏直接控制、错误难以纠正。作者的出发点是：定位 affordance 本质上是感知判断，不必用文字论证出来。
AI.method: 输入：一个操作（operation）请求与物体图像。流程：冻结的分割器（segmenter）提出候选区域，System One 模型不做文字生成，只在单次前向中直接判定每个候选是否执行该操作。框架按 物体→部件→子部件 逐层确认候选，并在层与层之间双向传递证据，使各层相互纠正。模型侧：作者指出已有 System One 模型面向通用决策、一次只判断一个候选，不适合本框架的区域式提问，因此该模型直接以框架自身产生的请求为训练信号，并一次性判断某一层的全部候选。输出：被确认为执行该操作的区域（部件/子部件级）。相对基线的改动在于：把“生成思维链再转成区域”换成“对候选区域做逐层确认的直接判定，无需文本”。
AI.result: 摘要只给出相对性结论，未报告任何数值。作者称：仅在 InstructPart 上训练、并用与定义对齐的操作词评测时，该方法在域内以及向 UMD、IIT-AFF 的零样本迁移中优于 chain-of-thought 方法；在同一框架下与已有 System One 模型相比总体更好，且所需 judge 请求更少；作者称这是首个把 System One 模型用于 affordance grounding 的方法。摘要未报告具体指标、数值、单位或统计显著性，也未报告真实机器人实验。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：它把“找到可操作部位”从语言推理任务改写为逐层候选确认的感知判定任务，让语义决策与最终区域范围直接挂钩，并减少 judge 请求次数，同时保留冻结分割器。证据边界是摘要仅声明相对优势与“首个”这一novelty，未给数值、未给延迟或算力测量，也未给真实机器人验证；因此只能作为“作者自述的性能与效率方向改善”，不能视为已量化的加速或部署结论。
AI.core_method: 冻结分割器产生候选区域，System One 模型单次前向判定该层全部候选是否执行所请求操作，并在物体—部件—子部件各层之间双向传递证据以互相校正。

key_results.finding: 在仅用 InstructPart 训练、以定义对齐操作词评测的条件下，作者称方法在域内及向 UMD、IIT-AFF 的零样本迁移中优于 chain-of-thought 方法；摘要未给出任何数值。
key_results.setting: 训练集：仅 InstructPart；评测词表：定义对齐的操作词；评测域：域内（InstructPart）与零样本迁移（UMD、IIT-AFF）；对比对象：chain-of-thought 方法。摘要未报告具体指标、数值与统计信息。
key_results.evidence_quote: Trained only on InstructPart and evaluated with definition-aligned operation words, outperforms chain-of-thought methods in domain and in zero-shot transfer to UMD and IIT-AFF

key_results.finding: 在同一框架下与已有 System One 模型比较，作者称本方法总体更好且需要更少的 judge 请求；摘要未给出请求数量或比值。
key_results.setting: 对比条件：同一确认框架内运行；对比对象：已有 System One 模型；度量：总体表现与 judge 请求数。摘要未报告具体数值、单位或测量方式。
key_results.evidence_quote: is better overall than existing System One models run in the same framework, and needs fewer judge requests

key_results.finding: 作者声称这是首个把 System One 模型引入 affordance grounding 的方法（novelty 声明，非量化结果）。
key_results.setting: 摘要未报告支撑该声明的对比方法清单或验证方式。
key_results.evidence_quote: To our knowledge, is the first approach to bring System One models to affordance grounding.

limitations: 作者自述的是既有方法的局限（System Two 推理开销大、语义决策难以控制区域范围、错误难纠正；已有 System One 模型面向通用决策、一次只判一个候选），并非本文自身缺陷。
摘要未报告任何数值结果：无指标、数值、单位、基线具体配置、消融或统计显著性，因此“优于”“更好”“更少请求”的程度不可量化。
摘要未报告真实机器人部署与硬件/延迟测量，也未报告推理耗时或算力的实际对比，尽管动机部分提到推理开销；这些属于“摘要未报告”，不能据此断言方法不具备相应能力。

02dcb2f08cab0ad775e93c1600c2af3a5b830c93.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
02dcb2f08cab0ad775e93c1600c2af3a5b830c93.comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Project page: this https URL
02dcb2f08cab0ad775e93c1600c2af3a5b830c93.summary: Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks. Several recent works expose the benchmark's success criteria to the learning agent, a practice we call Criteria Exposure (CE). These criteria, originally written to verify policies trained by imitation learning, often demand more than the corresponding language instructions, so a score from such a verifier may not faithfully reflect whether the instructed task was completed, especially for robot-control programs written by an agent. As embodied coding agents report ever higher benchmark scores, a natural question arises: when a coding agent is exposed to the benchmark's criteria, does it generate code that better performs the instructed task, or code that simply overfits to the verification criteria? We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions. More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks. We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.

AI.tldr: 针对机器人仿真基准中把成功判定标准暴露给自改进具身编码智能体的 Criteria Exposure（CE），作者用有/无 CE 的受控实验检验它是否只是过拟合验证器。结果显示 CE 能快速提高给定标准下的成功率，但标准轻微改动后优势消失、跨任务迁移差；作者提出的 instruction-faithful criteria 更能反映智能体生成程序的性能。
AI.motivation: 基准成功标准原为验证模仿学习策略而写，常比对应语言指令要求更多，因此验证器分数未必反映指定任务是否完成；当具身编码智能体报告更高分时，需判断它学到任务还是过拟合验证标准。
AI.method: 输入是机器人仿真基准中的语言指令与成功标准；自改进具身编码智能体据此编写机器人控制程序。作者进行受控实验：一组暴露基准成功标准（CE），一组不暴露；随后报告在给定标准下的成功率、标准轻微改动后的表现、技能跨任务迁移，并额外提出 instruction-faithful criteria 来评估智能体生成程序。输出是生成的代码/程序及其评价。
AI.result: 作者报告：CE 下智能体能快速生成在给定标准下成功率更高的代码，但该优势在标准轻微改动且不违背原指令时消失；CE 下发展的技能跨任务迁移差；其提出的 instruction-faithful criteria 更能反映智能体生成程序的性能。摘要未给出任何具体数值、基准名称或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型研究的含义是：在仿真基准上让编码智能体看到验证标准可能抬高分数并造成跨任务虚假泛化，评估应改用与指令一致的判定标准。证据仅来自摘要，无具体数值、真实机器人结果或独立复现。
AI.core_method: 让自改进编码智能体在机器人仿真基准中生成机器人控制程序，并比较暴露/不暴露基准成功标准，再用轻微改动标准、跨任务迁移和指令忠实标准来评估。

key_results.finding: 有 CE 时，智能体快速生成在给定 criteria 下成功率更高的代码，但 criteria 轻微改动且不偏离原指令后，该优势消失。
key_results.setting: 任务：机器人仿真基准中的自改进编码智能体生成机器人控制程序；比较条件：有 CE 与无 CE；指标：给定 criteria 下的成功率；数值与基准名称：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions.

key_results.finding: CE 下智能体发展的技能跨任务迁移表现差。
key_results.setting: 任务：跨任务迁移评估；对象：在 CE 下训练/自改进的具身编码智能体；数值与具体任务：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks.

key_results.finding: 作者提出的 instruction-faithful criteria 更能反映智能体生成程序的性能。
key_results.setting: 对象：智能体生成的机器人控制程序；比较：instruction-faithful criteria 与原有验证 criteria；量化对比与基准：摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.

limitations: 作者报告的现象限制：CE 带来的给定 criteria 成功率优势在 criteria 轻微改动后消失，且 CE 下技能跨任务迁移差。
摘要未报告：具体机器人仿真基准名称、成功率数值/单位、对照基线数值、样本量与统计显著性。
摘要未报告：instruction-faithful criteria 的构建细节，以及是否存在真实机器人实验或量化消融验证。

9645ad40b6a6b3eb2a6e058bfd10e9763b6ddf39.title: Kinematic Hypothesis Context: Embodiment-Conditioned Learned Video Coding for Bandwidth-Limited Robot Policy Uplinks
9645ad40b6a6b3eb2a6e058bfd10e9763b6ddf39.comment: 15 pages, 12 figures. Preprint; supplementary material and code to be released upon formal publication
9645ad40b6a6b3eb2a6e058bfd10e9763b6ddf39.summary: Robots increasingly run large vision-language-action policies on remote servers, making the camera uplink the bottleneck. Existing video codecs spend bits on content the receiver could predict: the robot's own motion. We introduce the kinematic hypothesis context, a zero-rate conditioning signal that both ends build from joint states, the robot model and the camera calibration. Ego-motion homographies, per-link robot reprojections, an end-effector plane and a background memory warp the previous reconstruction into hypotheses that condition a learned video codec. We prove that history-only and global-pose conditioning with a limited receptive field cannot access this information under large motion, and that coding gains become task gains at the policy's success cliff. On LIBERO, the context saves 23.9% bit rate over a capacity-matched history-conditioned codec and 40-56% over x264, x265 and SVT-AV1, and needs 23.2% fewer bits than DCVC-RT at equal policy action deviation; trained to lower rates, it matches DCVC-RT in PSNR. In closed loop at equal rate, OpenVLA-OFT success nearly doubles from 22.8% to 43.1% at 6 kbps (72.6% with lower-rate training, 23.6 points above DCVC-RT), pi_0.5 success rises from 55.5% to 77.4%, and the gain grows under packet loss. The context transfers across three codec hosts and to real robot data.

AI.tldr: 针对远程部署VLA策略时相机上行带宽成为瓶颈的问题，作者提出"运动学假设上下文"：用关节状态、机器人模型与相机标定在收发两端零码率构造运动假设帧，作为条件信号驱动学习式视频编解码器。LIBERO上比特率下降，等码率闭环中策略成功率上升。
AI.motivation: 机器人越来越多地把大型视觉-语言-动作策略放在远端服务器上运行，相机上行链路因此成为瓶颈。现有视频编解码器把比特花在接收端本可预测的内容上，即机器人自身的运动——这部分信息发送端和接收端其实都能从机器人状态推出来。
AI.method: 输入是上一帧重建、关节状态、机器人模型与相机标定。方法在编解码两端零码率地构造一组"运动学假设"：自我运动单应、逐连杆机器人重投影、末端执行器平面与背景记忆，把上一帧重建扭曲成若干候选假设帧，作为条件信号送入学习式视频编解码器；输出是供远端策略解码使用的比特流。相对摘要所述基线（仅历史条件化、全局位姿条件化）的改变在于：条件信号携带的是与具体机器人构型和相机标定绑定的运动学先验，而非从像素历史中估计的位姿；作者并证明在运动较大时，仅历史与全局位姿条件化配合有限感受野无法获取该信息。
AI.result: 码率（LIBERO）：相比容量匹配的历史条件化编解码器节省23.9%比特率，相比x264、x265与SVT-AV1节省40-56%；在等策略动作偏差下比DCVC-RT少用23.2%比特，且在按更低码率训练时PSNR与DCVC-RT持平。闭环任务（LIBERO，等码率）：OpenVLA-OFT成功率从22.8%升至43.1%（6 kbps），采用低码率训练后为72.6%，比DCVC-RT高23.6个百分点；pi_0.5成功率从55.5%升至77.4%；作者称丢包条件下增益更大。迁移：上下文跨三个编解码器宿主迁移，并迁移到真实机器人数据（摘要未报告真实机器人数值结果）。理论：作者证明在运动较大时，仅历史与全局位姿条件化配合有限感受野无法访问该信息；并称编码增益在策略成功率悬崖处转化为任务增益。以上均为作者自报，未经独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 若上述结果成立，说明把机器人本体运动学作为零码率条件信号，可以同时改善上行码率与闭环任务成功率，且不绑定单一编解码器宿主。对具身智能的意义在于：策略上行的编码设计可以把"机器人知道自己怎么动"这一具身先验显式交给学习式编解码器，而不是让码率去重复编码可预测的运动。证据边界：任务成功率数字来自LIBERO闭环仿真，真实机器人部分摘要只给出"迁移到真实机器人数据"的定性说法，未报告指标；理论结论的适用范围限于摘要所述的"历史/全局位姿条件化 + 有限感受野 + 大运动"设定。
AI.core_method: 用关节状态、机器人模型和相机标定在两端零码率生成运动假设帧，把上一帧重建扭曲后作为条件信号送入学习式视频编解码器。

key_results.finding: 在LIBERO上，该上下文相比容量匹配的历史条件化编解码器节省23.9%比特率，相比x264、x265与SVT-AV1节省40-56%比特率。
key_results.setting: 数据集/环境：LIBERO；对比基线：容量匹配的历史条件化编解码器，以及x264、x265、SVT-AV1；摘要未报告真实机器人条件下的码率结果。
key_results.evidence_quote: On LIBERO, the context saves 23.9% bit rate over a capacity-matched history-conditioned codec and 40-56% over x264, x265 and SVT-AV1

key_results.finding: 等码率闭环下OpenVLA-OFT成功率从22.8%提升到43.1%（6 kbps），使用低码率训练后达到72.6%，比DCVC-RT高23.6个百分点。
key_results.setting: LIBERO闭环评测，等码率6 kbps，对比基线含DCVC-RT；摘要未报告真实机器人闭环条件下的对应数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: In closed loop at equal rate, OpenVLA-OFT success nearly doubles from 22.8% to 43.1% at 6 kbps (72.6% with lower-rate training, 23.6 points above DCVC-RT)

key_results.finding: 在闭环等码率设定下，第二个策略pi_0.5的成功率从55.5%提升到77.4%。
key_results.setting: 闭环等码率评测，策略为pi_0.5；摘要未报告该结果的码率数值、任务套件细节与真实机器人验证。
key_results.evidence_quote: pi_0.5 success rises from 55.5% to 77.4%

limitations: 作者自述的限制（以证明形式给出）：仅历史条件化与全局位姿条件化、配合有限感受野，在大运动下无法访问该运动学信息；摘要未报告其他作者自述的弱点（如失败案例、失效条件）。
摘要未报告：真实机器人实验的定量结果。摘要只称上下文"迁移到真实机器人数据"，未给出任何任务、指标或数值。
摘要未报告：丢包场景的具体丢包率与对应指标、端到端时延与两端计算开销、训练数据规模、运行次数与统计显著性，也未给出各基线在闭环中的完整配置。

574954e83b53cbe4564e22f752226093e72184bc.title: Not Losing Your Way: Mitigating Visual-Inertial Odometry Drift through On-Demand Visual Feature Creation
574954e83b53cbe4564e22f752226093e72184bc.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2027)
574954e83b53cbe4564e22f752226093e72184bc.summary: Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) can degrade during aerial inspection in repetitive or poorly textured environments. We propose an active environment-modification framework for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) relying on cameras and an inertial measurement unit only, without prior maps or additional localization sensors. Inspired by the fairy tale of Tom Thumb, the UAV creates visual features on demand by releasing ground markers or marking walls through physical contact. An information-based indicator triggers interventions using temporal confirmation and hysteresis. Evaluation includes three simulated environments and a 900-run factorial campaign. Lower cruise speed and active marking are associated with reduced divergence, while accuracy among non-divergent runs depends on speed-strategy interactions. Corridor experiments, with five runs per configuration, use OptiTrack for flight control while VIO-based marking decisions remain active online. The combined framework reduces the reported position root mean square error by approximately 35% relative to baseline VIO, supporting active feature creation for drift mitigation.

AI.tldr: 针对重复或弱纹理环境中空中巡检的VIO退化，作者提出仅用相机+IMU的无人机"主动改造环境"框架：由信息量指标（含时间确认与滞回）决定何时干预，无人机按需在地面释放标记或通过物理接触在墙面留痕，现场生成视觉特征。摘要报告位置RMSE相对基线VIO降低约35%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出VIO在重复或弱纹理环境中执行空中巡检时会退化；作者设定的前提是不使用先验地图、也不增加额外定位传感器，因此缺少在不改变硬件配置的前提下主动维持可定位性的手段。
AI.method: 输入是无人机机载相机的图像与IMU测量，方法并不替换VIO前端，而是在其外层增加一个主动改造环境的闭环：一个基于信息的指标配合时间确认与滞回机制，判断何时漂移风险已足够高而需要干预；被触发后，无人机通过释放地面标记，或通过物理接触在墙面留下印记，来凭空创建新的视觉特征，供VIO继续跟踪。输出是更稳定的位姿/里程计估计以及被在线执行的干预决策。相对基线，改变的是"环境被动被观测"这一前提——无人机成为视觉特征的主动创造者。
AI.result: 作者报告：综合框架使位置RMSE相对基线VIO降低约35%（相对百分比改善，非百分点）；较低巡航速度与主动标记同更少的发散相关；在非发散运行中，精度取决于速度与策略的交互。评测覆盖三个仿真环境与一次900次运行的因子实验，另有走廊实验每配置5次运行、用OptiTrack做飞行控制而VIO标记决策在线保持激活。摘要未给出绝对误差数值、单位与统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向的意义在于：把"在哪里、何时改造环境以获得可观测性"当作闭环决策问题，而非仅改进传感器融合。摘要层面的证据限于作者报告的仿真环境（三个）与走廊实验（每配置5次运行，即900次运行因子实验之外的补充），因此结论应限定为"主动特征创建是一种可行的漂移缓解思路"，其对更广场景与室外部署的效果尚未由摘要支持，全部为作者自报结果、未经独立验证。
AI.core_method: 用带时间确认与滞回的信息量指标在线判断何时需要干预，再由无人机通过投放地面标记或接触式墙面标记现场"造"出可供VIO跟踪的新视觉特征。

key_results.finding: 综合框架将报告的位置均方根误差（RMSE）相对基线VIO降低约35%（相对改善）。
key_results.setting: 摘要未报告绝对RMSE数值与单位、具体基准配置，也未说明该35%来自仿真还是走廊实验。
key_results.evidence_quote: The combined framework reduces the reported position root mean square error by approximately 35% relative to baseline VIO, supporting active feature creation for drift mitigation.

key_results.finding: 较低巡航速度与主动标记策略与更少的发散相关；而在未发散的运行中，精度取决于速度与策略之间的交互。
key_results.setting: 三个仿真环境与900次运行因子实验中的变量分析；摘要未报告各因子的效应量或显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: Lower cruise speed and active marking are associated with reduced divergence, while accuracy among non-divergent runs depends on speed-strategy interactions.

limitations: 摘要未报告绝对误差数值、单位、置信区间或统计显著性，因此35%只可视为作者自报的相对改善。
摘要未报告两种干预方式（释放地面标记 vs. 接触式墙面标记）各自的贡献、触发频率与代价，也未给出消融结果。
部分结果未附可定位的摘要原句，或数字未出现在所附依据中，未作为关键结果展示。

d2c3a17f51a069517170acd820330c5db58e3237.title: Training-Independent Validation of a Learning-Based Controller for Stunt Maneuvers
d2c3a17f51a069517170acd820330c5db58e3237.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Video: this https URL
d2c3a17f51a069517170acd820330c5db58e3237.summary: Learned controllers for vehicle maneuvers are usually validated under the conditions and objective used to train them, where they appear highly reliable, yet the parameters that change on real roads are often not those the model was trained on. We argue that validation must be independent of training: it should vary physical parameters that training kept fixed and use acceptance criteria absent from the training objective. A learning-based control policy, G-Maneuver, with 90.11% success is tested for stunt-level maneuvers. A looser terminal-heading score ranked the worst setting as the best. Because real stunt tests are safety-critical, a simulation-to-reality-to-simulation (Sim2Real2Sim) loop uses the simulation to select safe zones for real-vehicle trials with 16.9% acceptance. Automotive safety analysis frameworks are used to identify parameters for validation using coverage tests. We demonstrated that the kinematic stunt-driving indicators, namely heading change, sideslip, and speed-normalized yaw rate, match between simulation and the real world, while force and roll indicators do not, which identifies the indicators that can support safe deployment. A video of the experiments is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 学习型车辆特技控制器通常在训练条件与训练目标下验证而显得可靠，但真车变化的参数并非训练时所用的参数。作者主张验证应与训练解耦，并以 G-Maneuver（90.11% 成功率）为例说明：较宽松的终端航向评分会把最差设置误判为最好，而 Sim2Real2Sim 回路以 16.9% 接受率为真车试验筛选安全区。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，学习型车辆机动控制器通常只在训练所用的条件和目标下验证，因而看起来高度可靠；但真实道路上变化的参数往往不是模型被训练过的那些参数，导致这类验证不能代表部署表现。
AI.method: 输入是一个已学习到的控制策略 G-Maneuver（面向特技级车辆机动）。方法不重训策略，而是改变训练时被固定住的物理参数，并采用训练目标中不存在的验收准则来做验证；借助汽车安全分析框架与覆盖性测试挑选需要验证的参数。随后用 simulation-to-reality-to-simulation（Sim2Real2Sim）回路，让仿真为真车试验挑选安全区。输出是对同一控制器在训练外参数与外部准则下的表现判断，以及仿真与真车之间哪些指标一致、哪些不一致的结论。
AI.result: 作者报告：G-Maneuver 在特技级机动上成功率为 90.11%；使用较宽松的终端航向评分时，最差设置被排为最好；Sim2Real2Sim 回路用仿真选定安全区后进行真车试验，接受率为 16.9%；运动学特技驾驶指标（航向变化、侧滑、速度归一化偏航率）在仿真与真实世界之间一致，而力与侧倾指标不一致。摘要未报告真车试验规模、统计显著性基线或覆盖性测试的具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型的含义是：在训练条件内的高成功率不足以支持部署判断，需要用与训练解耦的参数扰动和外部验收准则来检验策略。作者据此指出，只有仿真与真车一致的那部分运动学指标可支撑安全部署，而力与侧倾指标不能。该结论仅基于摘要所述实验，未经独立验证，且真车试验规模与统计细节在摘要中缺失。
AI.core_method: 不重训策略，而是改动训练中被固定的物理参数、改用训练目标之外的验收准则来独立验证同一控制器，并用仿真为真车试验划定安全区。

key_results.finding: 学习型控制策略 G-Maneuver 在特技级机动上报告 90.11% 成功率。
key_results.setting: 任务：特技级车辆机动；基线：摘要未报告；条件：摘要未报告（未说明仿真或真车、样本量）。
key_results.evidence_quote: A learning-based control policy, G-Maneuver, with 90.11% success is tested for stunt-level maneuvers.

key_results.finding: 使用较宽松的终端航向评分时，评价结果把最差设置排为最好，说明训练目标内的指标可能无法区分优劣。
key_results.setting: 任务：训练独立验证中的评分/排序比较；对照：更严格的训练目标内准则（摘要仅以“looser”表述）；条件：摘要未报告具体设置数量与场景。
key_results.evidence_quote: A looser terminal-heading score ranked the worst setting as the best.

key_results.finding: 运动学特技驾驶指标（航向变化、侧滑、速度归一化偏航率）在仿真与真实世界之间一致，而力与侧倾指标不一致。
key_results.setting: 任务：仿真与真车的指标一致性比较（Sim2Real2Sim 回路）；指标：heading change、sideslip、speed-normalized yaw rate 与 force、roll；条件：摘要未报告车辆平台、试验次数或一致性判据阈值。
key_results.evidence_quote: the kinematic stunt-driving indicators, namely heading change, sideslip, and speed-normalized yaw rate, match between simulation and the real world, while force and roll indicators do not

limitations: 作者未在摘要中自述方法局限；摘要仅给出验证主张与结果，遗漏项属于摘要未报告而非作者承认的缺陷。
摘要未报告覆盖性测试的具体结果（验证了哪些参数、覆盖程度、参数取值范围），也未报告安全分析框架的量化输出。
摘要未报告真车试验的车辆平台、试验次数、安全区数量、失败案例细节与统计显著性；16.9% 接受率的含义（分母与判据）在摘要中不明确。

fe7b58f51562285304c75dfc17b3f5739f89cc78.title: Whole-Body Elasto-Geometrical Calibration of Wheeled Humanoid Robots Using a Shared-Waist Dual-Chain Model
fe7b58f51562285304c75dfc17b3f5739f89cc78.summary: Wheeled humanoid robots carry both arms on one actuated waist, usually without torque sensors, so the accuracy of both end-effectors depends on a single waist model. After a first stage that estimates the tracker and target extrinsics, we identify the waist and both arms in one problem from the target positions on both flanges, measured by an optical tracker. The kinematic model is complete, with waist-base, parallel-axis, and branch parameters; arm compliances are driven by measured torques and waist compliances by gravity torques of the robot's mass model; and Gaussian priors with evidence-maximizing scales stabilize the estimate. Independent and sequential single-chain calibration are restrictions of this problem, and its waist information is the sum of the single-chain Schur complements. On two robots with different waists, each without and with a payload, calibration reduces the mean errors on held-out poses from 11.3-31.1 mm to 0.50-1.11 mm. For every training-set size from 20 poses to all, the method has 17-63% lower mean errors than adaptations of two published whole-body calibration methods, mainly through the waist compliance. Independent calibration yields two waist models; using either for both arms raises the other arm's error to up to 3.21 mm.

AI.tldr: 针对轮式人形机器人双臂共用一个驱动腰部、且通常无扭矩传感器的问题，作者提出共享腰部双链模型，把腰部和双臂的几何与柔顺参数联合辨识；在两个机器人上，留出位姿平均误差从 11.3-31.1 mm 降至 0.50-1.11 mm。
AI.motivation: 轮式人形机器人把双臂装在同一驱动腰部，通常没有扭矩传感器，因此两个末端的精度都依赖同一个腰部模型；独立或顺序的单链标定会产生两个腰部模型，双臂一致性难以保证。
AI.method: 输入是光学追踪器测量的两个法兰靶点位置；第一阶段估计追踪器与靶标外参，随后把腰部和双臂放在同一个问题中联合辨识。模型包含腰部-基座、平行轴与分支参数；手臂柔顺从测量扭矩获得，腰部柔顺从机器人质量模型的重力扭矩获得；用证据最大化尺度的高斯先验稳定估计。独立与顺序单链标定是该问题的受限形式，其腰部信息为单链 Schur 补之和。输出为共享腰部下的双臂运动学与柔顺参数。
AI.result: 作者报告：在两个不同腰部的机器人上，分别在无负载和带负载条件下，标定将留出位姿的平均误差从 11.3-31.1 mm 降至 0.50-1.11 mm。训练集规模从 20 个位姿到全部位姿的每个设置中，该方法的平均误差比两种已发表全身标定方法的适配版本低 17-63%，主要来自腰部柔顺性。独立标定会产生两个腰部模型；使用任一模型同时服务双臂会使另一条手臂的误差升至最多 3.21 mm。摘要未报告统计显著性、重复次数或计算耗时。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明共享腰部建模对双臂末端精度可能重要，尤其腰部柔顺被作者报告为误差降低的主要来源；但证据限于两个机器人的留出位姿标定，摘要未报告下游操作任务、长期稳定性或部署效果，不能推断任务级性能或跨构型泛化。对具身智能而言，这属于本体标定与柔顺建模层，而非策略或环境/世界模型本身。
AI.core_method: 用光学追踪器测两法兰靶点位置，把腰部和双臂放进一个共享腰部双链模型联合辨识，并用扭矩驱动的柔顺项和高斯先验稳定估计。

key_results.finding: 作者报告在两个不同腰部的机器人、每种无负载与带负载条件下，标定把留出位姿平均误差从 11.3-31.1 mm 降到 0.50-1.11 mm。
key_results.setting: 两个不同腰部的机器人；各在无负载与带负载条件下；指标为留出位姿平均误差（mm）；基线为标定前误差；摘要未报告统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: On two robots with different waists, each without and with a payload, calibration reduces the mean errors on held-out poses from 11.3-31.1 mm to 0.50-1.11 mm.

key_results.finding: 作者报告在训练集规模从 20 个位姿到全部位姿的每个设置下，该方法平均误差比两种已发表全身标定方法的适配版本低 17-63%，并称主要来自腰部柔顺性。
key_results.setting: 训练集规模从 20 poses 到全部；比较对象为两种已发表全身标定方法的适配版本；指标为平均误差相对降低幅度；摘要未报告绝对误差与统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: For every training-set size from 20 poses to all, the method has 17-63% lower mean errors than adaptations of two published whole-body calibration methods, mainly through the waist compliance.

key_results.finding: 作者报告独立标定会产生两个腰部模型；把任一模型用于双臂会使另一条手臂的误差升至最多 3.21 mm。
key_results.setting: 独立单链标定与共享腰部模型的对比；指标为另一条手臂误差（mm）；摘要未报告其他实验条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: Independent calibration yields two waist models; using either for both arms raises the other arm's error to up to 3.21 mm.

limitations: 作者未在摘要中明确列出方法局限性；摘要仅把“腰部通常无扭矩传感器、双臂精度依赖同一腰部模型”作为问题背景。
摘要未报告真实机器人与仿真的区分、机器人平台型号、负载质量、追踪器型号与标定耗时。
摘要未报告统计显著性、重复次数、训练/测试划分细节、下游操作任务验证或跨构型泛化结果。

417122e427afb88636a07ac492936ac3a7fc8923.title: RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines
417122e427afb88636a07ac492936ac3a7fc8923.summary: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing RM-VLM, a novel approach in which a large language model (LLM) generates an RM from a natural-language task description, and a vision-language model (VLM) acts as the labelling function, grounding the RM's propositions over image-based observations during RM-guided policy learning. A VLM-based value function estimator is used to assess the agent's progress towards each RM transition and derive a dense reward signal. We evaluate RM-VLM on three domains covering non-Markovian grid-world navigation, robotic manipulation, and 3D object collection. Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.

AI.tldr: RM-VLM 针对奖励机器（RM）需要为每个环境手工设计 proposition-grounding labelling function 的问题，用 LLM 从自然语言任务描述生成 RM，并用 VLM 在图像观测上接地命题、估计进度以形成稠密奖励；作者报告其在三个测试领域中的任务成功率均高于现有 VLM-based reward 方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.motivation: RM 能把非马尔可夫任务的历史依赖奖励写成自动机，但通常假设存在一个 labelling function / proposition-grounding oracle，且必须为每个环境手工工程化，限制其更广泛应用。
AI.method: 输入是自然语言任务描述；LLM 据此生成 RM。VLM 充当 labelling function，在 RM 引导的策略学习过程中，把 RM 的命题接地到基于图像的观测上。另用 VLM-based value function estimator 评估智能体朝每个 RM 转移的进度，并据此导出稠密奖励信号。相对被指出的基线，核心变化是用 LLM+VLM 自动完成 RM 生成与命题接地，而不是手工设计 labelling function。
AI.result: 作者报告：RM-VLM 在所有测试领域中的任务成功率 consistently 高于 existing VLM-based reward methods。摘要未报告具体成功率、提升幅度、单位或统计显著性，因此只能作为作者声称的相对优势，不能视为独立验证的数值结论。测试领域为：non-Markovian grid-world navigation、robotic manipulation、3D object collection；摘要未说明是仿真还是真实机器人。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向，该工作展示了一条减少 RM 手工命题接地成本的路径：用语言模型生成任务时序结构，用视觉语言模型从图像观测中在线接地命题并产生稠密奖励。证据边界是仅有摘要层面、无论文数值和真实部署条件，不能推断其实际机器人性能、效率或泛化能力。

key_results.finding: 作者报告 RM-VLM 在所有测试领域中的任务成功率高于现有 VLM-based reward 方法；摘要未给出具体数值、单位或提升幅度。
key_results.setting: 任务领域：non-Markovian grid-world navigation、robotic manipulation、3D object collection；比较对象：existing VLM-based reward methods；摘要未报告基准名称、具体指标值、样本量、统计显著性，也未说明仿真或真实机器人。
key_results.evidence_quote: Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.

limitations: 作者报告的前作局限：RM 假设 labelling function / proposition-grounding oracle，且必须为每个环境手工工程化；摘要未将这一局限归为 RM-VLM 自身局限。
摘要未报告 RM-VLM 自身的失败情形、适用范围或作者承认的局限。
摘要未报告 LLM/VLM 具体模型、训练或推理开销、真实机器人实验条件、消融实验与统计显著性。

9e43ce06fd03b45d7cf8c62a5bcec5ef14a0b7e2.title: Real-Time Event-Based LED Tracking and Pose Estimation with PWM-Encoded Markers
9e43ce06fd03b45d7cf8c62a5bcec5ef14a0b7e2.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
9e43ce06fd03b45d7cf8c62a5bcec5ef14a0b7e2.summary: Event cameras are neuromorphic vision sensors with pixels that independently and asynchronously respond to brightness changes at microsecond resolution, supporting state estimation under rapid motion, motion blur, and high dynamic range (HDR) illumination. This also enables capture of high-frequency blinking patterns from light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Based on this, we propose a real-time event-based framework for LED tracking and six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) relative pose estimation using pulse-width modulation (PWM)-encoded LED markers. Multiple LEDs share a common blinking frequency and encode identities through distinct PWM duty cycles, reducing frequency-resource requirements and computational cost. Our dual-rate asynchronous tracking framework combines low-rate LED detection with high-rate raw-event updates, maintaining robust LED identity association and accurate pixel-level tracking under rapid motion. LED identities and positions establish reliable 2D-3D correspondences for real-time metric 6-DoF relative pose estimation. Extensive evaluations on a self-collected dataset demonstrate robustness under large motion flow and transient image-plane LED overlap. Furthermore, we develop a coordinated robotic platform comprising a quadrotor and a Mecanum-wheeled mobile robot, demonstrating the proposed framework's potential for closed-loop drone guidance through hovering and target-following experiments under time-varying HDR illumination, with onboard deployment on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. The dataset and implementation will be released to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 针对快速运动、运动模糊与HDR光照下的事件相机LED跟踪与相对位姿估计，作者用共享闪烁频率、不同PWM占空比编码LED身份，并以低速率LED检测加高速率原始事件更新的双速率异步框架输出实时度量6-DoF相对位姿；自采数据集实验与四旋翼-麦轮车平台演示显示鲁棒性和机载部署潜力，摘要未报告数值结果。

AI.method: 输入是事件相机异步事件流和PWM编码LED标志。作者让多个LED共用同一闪烁频率，用不同PWM占空比编码身份，从而减少频率资源需求与计算成本。跟踪采用双速率异步框架：低速率进行LED检测，高速率用原始事件更新，以维持LED身份关联和快速运动下的像素级跟踪。LED身份与位置提供2D-3D对应，最终输出实时度量6-DoF相对位姿。摘要未给出相对基线的具体实现差异。
AI.result: 作者在自采数据集上报告对大运动流和图像平面LED短暂重叠具有鲁棒性，但未报告数值指标、单位或基线对比。作者还搭建四旋翼与Mecanum轮式移动机器人协同平台，在时变HDR光照下通过悬停和目标跟随实验展示闭环无人机引导潜力，并在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上机载部署。数据集和实现将发布。以上均为作者自述，摘要未报告量化评估。

2c1e59ddb3b325ce6fe08af190a8c10b4c5ea8e3.title: Development of Anthropomorphic Arm for collaborative and Home Service Robot CHARMIE
2c1e59ddb3b325ce6fe08af190a8c10b4c5ea8e3.summary: Service Robots are becoming a reality and are progressing by leaps and bounds. Alongside this avenue of robotics is also the field of prosthetics, which is evolving rapidly. These topics are hot cakes in the industry and are widely developed. Some have one quality, and some have others, but are making a shoreline towards success. The development of arm and hand as individual or as a package is becoming common as more and more advanced collaborative robots come to the surface and join their human counterparts in the real world. This dissertation presents an open-source 3D-printed arm which was assembled and programmed on two fronts. The first is the control of the hand by utilising teleoperation with a camera and ML-based hand pose estimation. Secondly, it is the control via kinematics utilising the Denavit-Hartenberg method to define the motion and to find the position of the end effector in 3D space.

AI.tldr: 论文报告一台开源、3D 打印的拟人机械臂/手，被装配并编程为两条控制路线：一是用摄像头加机器学习手部姿态估计进行遥操作控制手，二是用 Denavit-Hartenberg 方法做运动学建模以确定末端执行器在三维空间中的位置。摘要未给出任何定量结果。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人与假肢两个方向都在快速发展，具备不同特性的机械臂/手以单独或成套形式开发越来越普遍；作者希望为协作与家庭服务机器人 CHARMIE 提供一条可复现的开源 3D 打印拟人臂方案。
AI.method: 输入有两个层面：摄像头拍摄的人手图像，以及用于运动学建模的 DH 参数。方法在两方面做出改变：其一是把摄像头采集与基于机器学习的手部姿态估计接到手上，实现遥操作式的手部控制；其二是用 Denavit-Hartenberg 方法定义手臂运动并求解末端执行器在三维空间中的位置。产出是一台开源、3D 打印的拟人臂与手，装配并编程用于协作与家庭服务机器人 CHARMIE。摘要未说明所用网络结构、参数估计精度或控制器实现细节。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量结果：没有任务/基准、指标、数值、单位或对比基线。作者也未声称 SOTA。摘要只做了总体趋势性陈述，例如服务机器人正在成为现实并"progressing by leaps and bounds"，这属于定性表述，不构成可核对的实验结论。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能研究的价值主要在于一条可复现的开源 3D 打印拟人臂硬件入口，外加"视觉手部姿态估计→遥操作手部"与"DH 运动学求末端位姿"两条控制路线的组合思路。但由于摘要未给出精度、负载、速度、成功率或与基线的比较，无法判断该臂在协作或家庭服务场景中的实际可用性与可靠性；也不清楚两种控制方式是否在同一系统上做过对比评测。
AI.core_method: 用摄像头加机器学习估计人手姿态来遥操作驱动 3D 打印机械手，并用 DH 运动学参数定义手臂运动、求解末端执行器三维位置。
limitations: 作者未在摘要中报告任何量化指标（载荷、定位精度、遥操作成功率、时延等），也未报告与基线或商用机械臂的对比 —— 摘要未报告。

e489d99b93e8c14c51c764586562f632c8e6f8cd.title: Kinematic analysis of a double-closed-loop four-bar chain-based leg for a multimodal quadruped-pentarotor robot
e489d99b93e8c14c51c764586562f632c8e6f8cd.comment: Journal paper submitted to Robotica with ID:ROB-2026-0373
e489d99b93e8c14c51c764586562f632c8e6f8cd.summary: This paper presents the kinematic modeling and singularity analysis of a three-degree-of-freedom, double four-bar closed-loop quadruped leg mechanism. This leg is essential for transitioning between the two operational modes; therefore, it is examined in both joint and task spaces, leading to the development of its Jacobian matrix, which is vital for designing the gaits required for terrestrial mode and mid-air aerial reconfiguration (for aerial mode). Various gaits are devised for the system's motion in the MATLAB simulation, and their practical implementation on the single-leg test rig is demonstrated.

AI.tldr: 针对双四杆闭环三自由度四足腿机构，摘要报告在关节/任务空间完成运动学与奇异分析并导出雅可比矩阵，以支撑地面步态与空中重构步态设计；仅在MATLAB仿真中设计步态并在单腿试验台演示，未报告数值指标。

AI.method: 输入是该三自由度双四杆闭环四足腿机构的运动学描述。方法在关节空间和任务空间对其建模并做奇异分析，产出雅可比矩阵；该矩阵被用于设计地面模式步态和空中模式的中空/空中重构步态。摘要未说明与何种基线或已有机构相比，也未给出具体建模方程、求解步骤或控制方法。输出包括MATLAB仿真中的多种步态以及单腿试验台上的实现演示。

60503ff74ff3ef9ac19b6a5816a5469261f5011f.title: Transformer-Based Trajectory Prescription for sEMG-Optimizing Robot-Mediated Rehabilitation
60503ff74ff3ef9ac19b6a5816a5469261f5011f.comment: Accepted for presentation and publication in the 2026 Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL). PMLR, 2026
60503ff74ff3ef9ac19b6a5816a5469261f5011f.summary: Robot-mediated rehabilitation has the potential to deliver high-intensity, individualized therapy, but existing systems (which have not consistently improved outcomes) typically prescribe kinematic trajectories rather than explicitly targeting the neuromotor activations thought to support recovery. To address this gap, and ultimately enable activation-optimizing rehabilitation robot behavior, we present a personalizable transformer-based model mapping individuals' muscle activations (as measured via surface electromyography) to prescribed contact force trajectories when interacting with an end-effector rehabilitation robot. The model uses a transformer encoder-decoder leveraging rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) to generate a latent representation of trajectory-relevant and user-specific neuromotor factors, and augments trajectory prediction with flow matching to produce a distribution over plausible prescriptions biased toward the training distribution. Using data from 16 healthy participants completing 15 isometric trajectory tracking tasks, we evaluate generalization across held-out tasks and users, as well as the feasibility of user-specific fine-tuning within a therapy-session timescale. The model achieves mean trajectory prediction errors of <8% on held out tasks and users, with effectively instantaneous deterministic inference and sub-second sampling of trajectory distributions. An initial test using the model during live rehabilitation tasks demonstrates that, on average, participants reach the target neuromotor activations with just 15% error accumulated throughout the task. These results provide a proof of concept for data-driven, activation-targeted trajectory prescription in robot-mediated rehabilitation and establish a foundation for future validation in clinical populations. Data and code have been open-sourced as part of the OpenRobotRehab project on SimTK.

AI.tldr: 现有的机器人康复系统多直接给定运动学轨迹，而不显式针对被认为有助恢复的神经肌肉激活。作者提出基于 transformer 编码器-解码器的个性化模型，把表面肌电（sEMG）映射为康复机器人应施加的接触力轨迹，并以流匹配生成轨迹分布。健康受试者数据上，留出任务与用户的平均轨迹预测误差低于 8%；一次实际康复任务测试中，受试者达到目标神经肌肉激活的累积误差平均为 15%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，机器人介导康复有潜力提供高强度、个体化治疗，但现有系统"并未一致地改善治疗结果"，其做法通常是给定运动学轨迹，而非显式以支撑恢复的神经肌肉激活为目标。作者要填补的正是"以激活为目标的处方"这一空缺。
AI.method: 输入是受试者的肌肉激活信号（经表面肌电测量）；输出是受试者与末端执行器康复机器人交互时应当被施加的接触力轨迹（即"处方"）。模型为 transformer 编码器-解码器，用旋转位置编码（RoPE）生成一个潜表示，用以概括与轨迹相关且因人而异的神经肌肉因素；并在轨迹预测之上加入流匹配，产生一个偏向训练分布的、合理处方的概率分布，而非单一确定性输出。相对摘要所述基线（直接给定运动学轨迹的系统），其改变在于把处方的目标变量换成神经肌肉激活对应的接触力轨迹，并支持在同一治疗会话时间尺度内做用户特定微调。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 16 名健康受试者、15 个等长收缩轨迹跟踪任务数据上，留出任务与留出用户的平均轨迹预测误差小于 8%，确定性推理"近乎即时"，轨迹分布采样为亚秒级。另有一次在真实康复任务中的初步测试，受试者平均以全任务累计 15% 的误差达到目标神经肌肉激活。摘要未给出与其它方法的定量对比、误差的统计细节或分布采样质量的量化结果；真实康复测试仅为初步单次测试。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向，这篇工作提供的是一个"以生理信号为条件、以交互力为输出"的个性化处方式策略雏形：用 sEMG 潜表示加流匹配生成可行力轨迹分布，并显示可在会话内完成用户适配。证据边界需注意：验证只在 16 名健康受试者的等长任务与一次初步实机测试上进行，作者自述这只是概念验证，临床人群验证尚待未来工作，因此不能推断临床疗效改善。
AI.core_method: 用带旋转位置编码的 transformer 编解码器把肌电信号编码为用户相关潜表示，再以流匹配生成接触力轨迹的分布作为康复处方。

key_results.finding: 留出任务与留出用户上的平均轨迹预测误差小于 8%，确定性推理近乎即时，轨迹分布采样为亚秒级。
key_results.setting: 16 名健康受试者、15 个等长轨迹跟踪任务；评测为跨留出任务与留出用户的泛化；基线对比摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: The model achieves mean trajectory prediction errors of <8% on held out tasks and users, with effectively instantaneous deterministic inference and sub-second sampling of trajectory distributions.

key_results.finding: 在真实康复任务中，受试者平均以全任务累计 15% 的误差达到目标神经肌肉激活。
key_results.setting: 真实康复任务中的一次初步测试（initial test）；样本量与统计细节摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: An initial test using the model during live rehabilitation tasks demonstrates that, on average, participants reach the target neuromotor activations with just 15% error accumulated throughout the task.

limitations: 作者自述的局限：结果仅为概念验证，尚待未来在临床人群中验证；受试者为 16 名健康参与者，而非患者。
作者自述的定位：现有康复系统未一致改善结果，本文目标是以激活为目标的处方，摘要未报告与既有系统在结局指标上的对照比较。
摘要未报告：误差指标的确切定义与统计显著性、流匹配所生成分布的质量度量、微调所需具体计算开销与数据量。

3a92e60dad88a27580b217bb6a43b52adda00aa8.title: PRISM: Primitive Routing via In-context Skill Mixing for Retentive VLA Adaptation
3a92e60dad88a27580b217bb6a43b52adda00aa8.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
3a92e60dad88a27580b217bb6a43b52adda00aa8.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise a single language-conditioned policy adaptable to many manipulation behaviors, yet deployment additionally requires skill retention and long-horizon composition: a policy must retain previously acquired skills and reuse them inside composite tasks whose behavior changes across phases. The standard recipe absorbs every new task into one shared update, which provides neither a parameter-level locus for reusable skills nor a mechanism for invoking each skill along the trajectory. We observe that this missing structure is latent rather than absent: per-skill low-rank updates of a pretrained VLA occupy a robustly distinguishable, low-dimensional subspace, and a single composite-task LoRA concentrates roughly half of its Frobenius energy in this subspace, against a near-zero matched random-rotation control. Building on this geometry, we introduce PRISM, which represents reusable skills as parameter-level primitives: each skill family is stored as a dedicated low-rank action-expert adapter in a primitive bank, primitives are augmented with skill-specific low-rank residuals and composed at inference by a per-chunk VLM-conditioned router that reads the prefix representation to track task progress, and the router is supervised by per-chunk labels from a deterministic, task-conditioned, action-derived oracle. During composite training, the vision encoder, the language LoRA, the skill residuals, the router, and the shared action projections and time MLP are updated; every primitive is held frozen, so the base per-skill action-expert adapters are preserved by construction. On RoboCasa365, PRISM achieves 56.43% atomic-skill success and reaches 20.00% on long-horizon composite tasks, while a standard $\pi_{0.5}$-LoRA two-stage fine-tune reaches 17.86% atomic and 17.50% composite success. We additionally validate PRISM on an AgileX PIPER real-robot setup.

AI.tldr: PRISM 把可复用技能表示为参数级低秩"原语"（primitive bank），在推理时由 VLM 逐块路由组合，从而在保留旧技能的同时完成长时程复合任务；在 RoboCasa365 上作者报告 56.43% 原子技能成功率与 20.00% 长时程复合成功率，并称在 AgileX PIPER 实机上做了验证。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出标准做法把每个新任务都吸收进一次共享更新，既没有"可复用技能的参数级落点"，也没有在轨迹中按阶段调用各技能的机制，因此无法满足部署所需的技能保持与长时程组合。作者主张这种缺失的结构其实潜伏存在：单技能的预训练 VLA 低秩更新落在可稳健区分的低维子空间里。
AI.method: 输入是语言条件操作任务（含原子技能与行为跨阶段变化的复合任务）。做法是把每个技能族存成一个专用的低秩 action-expert 适配器，组成"原语库"；每个原语再附加技能专属低秩残差；推理时由一个逐 chunk 的 VLM 条件路由器读取前缀表示来判断任务进度并组合原语，路由器用来自确定性、任务条件、由动作导出的 oracle 的逐 chunk 标签做监督。复合任务训练时更新视觉编码器、语言 LoRA、技能残差、路由器以及共享 action 投影和时间 MLP，而所有原语保持冻结，因此基础的单技能 action-expert 适配器在构造上被保留。输出是可在复合任务各阶段切换技能的语言条件策略。
AI.result: 作者在 RoboCasa365 上报告 PRISM 达到 56.43% 原子技能成功率和 20.00% 长时程复合任务成功率；作为对照，标准 π0.5-LoRA 两阶段微调为 17.86% 原子和 17.50% 复合。此外作者称在 AgileX PIPER 实机装置上对 PRISM 做了验证，但摘要未给出实机的任何数值结果。几何观察方面，作者报告单个复合任务 LoRA 约有"一半"的 Frobenius 能量集中在该低维子空间，而匹配的随机旋转对照接近零。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：把技能保持从"共享参数里的隐含性"改成参数级的可寻址原语，并让路由在推理时随任务进度切换，这为 VLA 的长时程组合提供了一种低秩适配路线。证据边界：只有 RoboCasa365 的数值结果和一个 π0.5-LoRA 两阶段微调对照被报告，实机验证仅被提及而无数值，因此不能据此推断实机性能或广泛的泛化性。
AI.core_method: 为每个技能族训练一个冻结的低秩 action-expert 适配器作为"原语"，再用 VLM 条件路由器按 chunk 决定当前该调用哪个原语来完成复合任务。

key_results.finding: 在 RoboCasa365 上，PRISM 达到 56.43% 原子技能成功率、20.00% 长时程复合任务成功率；标准 π0.5-LoRA 两阶段微调为 17.86% 原子、17.50% 复合。
key_results.setting: RoboCasa365 基准；对照为标准 π0.5-LoRA 两阶段微调；摘要未报告随机种子、试验次数或统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: On RoboCasa365, PRISM achieves 56.43% atomic-skill success and reaches 20.00% on long-horizon composite tasks, while a standard $\pi_{0.5}$-LoRA two-stage fine-tune reaches 17.86% atomic and 17.50% composite success.

key_results.finding: 单个复合任务 LoRA 约有一半 Frobenius 能量落在单技能低秩更新所占据的子空间中，而匹配的随机旋转对照接近零。
key_results.setting: 对预训练 VLA 的逐技能低秩更新所做子空间几何分析；摘要未报告参与分析的技能数量或统计检验。
key_results.evidence_quote: a single composite-task LoRA concentrates roughly half of its Frobenius energy in this subspace, against a near-zero matched random-rotation control.

key_results.finding: 作者称在 AgileX PIPER 实机装置上额外验证了 PRISM；摘要未给出任何实机数值指标。
key_results.setting: AgileX PIPER 实机装置；摘要未报告任务、成功率、试验次数等条件。
key_results.evidence_quote: We additionally validate PRISM on an AgileX PIPER real-robot setup.

limitations: 摘要未报告实机（AgileX PIPER）的任何定量结果，因此无法判断实机性能水平；这是信息缺失，而非作者声明的缺陷。
摘要未报告除单一 π0.5-LoRA 两阶段微调外的其他对照、消融（如去掉路由器或技能残差）或失败案例分析。
方法依赖由确定性、任务条件、动作导出的 oracle 生成逐 chunk 监督标签，摘要未讨论该 oracle 在真实数据或新型任务上的可用性与代价。

50e61ddee27cfb37d441176bda5a4fd16fd22097.title: Q-OIL: Optimistic Exploration in Learning from Human Interventions
50e61ddee27cfb37d441176bda5a4fd16fd22097.summary: As robots are deployed in the real world, they will inevitably make mistakes. Human interventions provide valuable feedback for improving their behavior, enabling them to adapt online to new scenarios. However, studying human-in-the-loop robot learning is difficult: real-world experiments are slow and expensive, so most algorithm development relies on simulated human models. We show that common human modeling assumptions do not match how real people intervene in practice. Through analyzing intervention data from human participants, we find that humans tend to intervene when agent progress stalls, and that their corrective actions are often suboptimal. Motivated by these findings, we introduce a progress-based model of human intervention that achieves higher rank correlation with real-user algorithm rankings, enabling realistic algorithm benchmarking and development in simulation. Building on these insights, we propose Q-OIL, a method that adds optimistic bonuses to intervention transitions in reinforcement learning and softly guides exploration toward human corrections. We find that decoupled critics are critical for stability because they prevent the bonuses from backing up to pre-intervention states. As a result, Q-OIL learns more efficiently than competitive baselines, achieving 10-50% higher success in simulation and on real robots, and improving pretrained VLAs on two bimanual manipulation tasks. As we ground both evaluation and algorithms in realistic human behavior, this work provides a practical path toward scalable robot learning from interventions.

AI.tldr: 真实世界人机在环学习代价高，多数算法开发依赖模拟人类模型；作者发现人类通常在 agent 进度停滞时介入且纠正动作常次优，据此提出基于进度的干预模型与 Q-OIL 方法。作者报告 Q-OIL 在仿真与真实机器人上比竞争基线成功率提高 10-50%，并提升两个双臂操作任务上的预训练 VLA。
AI.motivation: 机器人部署到真实世界必然犯错，人类干预是改进行为的宝贵反馈；但真实世界的人机在环实验慢且昂贵，算法开发大多依赖模拟人类模型，而常见的人类建模假设与真人实际干预方式不符。作者通过分析人类参与者的干预数据发现：人类倾向在 agent 进度停滞时介入，且其纠正动作常常是次优的。
AI.method: 输入是强化学习训练过程中的人类干预转移（状态、纠正动作）以及 agent 的进度信号。方法做两件事：一是在干预转移上加入乐观奖励加成（optimistic bonuses），二是软性引导探索朝人类纠正动作方向。关键设计是使用解耦 critic（decoupled critics）以保证稳定性，避免乐观加成回传到干预前状态。此外，作者提出一个基于进度的（progress-based）人类干预模型，用于在仿真中做更贴近真实用户的算法基准测试。输出是学习到的机器人策略，并可作用于预训练 VLA。相对基线的变化：从常规的从干预中学习/强化学习基线，改为“乐观加成 + 软引导 + 解耦 critic”的组合。
AI.result: 作者报告 Q-OIL 比竞争基线学习更高效，在仿真和真实机器人上成功率提高 10-50%，并在两个双臂操作任务上提升预训练 VLA；但摘要未说明该 10-50% 是相对提升还是百分点提升，也未给出具体任务名、基线名与统计信息。基于进度的干预模型在“与真实用户算法排序的秩相关性”上更高，但摘要未给出相关系数数值。作者称解耦 critic 对稳定性至关重要，摘要未给出对应消融数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把“评测所用的人类行为模型”和“从干预中学习的算法”都建立在对真实人类干预行为的观察上，为可扩展的机器人从干预中学习提供了一条路径，并显示其可迁移到真实机器人与预训练 VLA 微调场景。证据边界：以上均为作者自报结果，本文仅依据标题与摘要；具体仿真环境、真实机器人平台、基线集合、参与者规模与统计显著性在摘要中缺失，无法据此判断泛化性与稳健性。
AI.core_method: 对强化学习中的干预转移加入乐观奖励加成，并软性引导探索朝向人类纠正动作，同时用解耦 critic 阻止加成回传到干预前状态。

key_results.finding: 相比竞争基线，Q-OIL 学习更高效，在仿真与真实机器人上成功率提高 10-50%，并改善两个双臂操作任务上的预训练 VLA。
key_results.setting: 任务与基准：摘要仅说明仿真与真实机器人两类设置，以及两个双臂操作任务；基线名称、具体任务、10-50% 的单位（相对提升或百分点）均未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: As a result, Q-OIL learns more efficiently than competitive baselines, achieving 10-50% higher success in simulation and on real robots, and improving pretrained VLAs on two bimanual manipulation tasks.

key_results.finding: 所提出的基于进度的人类干预模型与真实用户算法排序的秩相关性更高，可用于在仿真中进行更贴近真实的算法基准测试。
key_results.setting: 依据对人类参与者干预数据的分析构建；比较对象为真实用户算法排序；相关系数数值、参与者数量与具体算法集合摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: we introduce a progress-based model of human intervention that achieves higher rank correlation with real-user algorithm rankings, enabling realistic algorithm benchmarking and development in simulation

key_results.finding: 解耦 critic 对稳定性是关键，因为它阻止乐观加成回传到干预前状态。
key_results.setting: 该结论以作者陈述形式给出；对应消融实验的设置与数值在摘要中未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: We find that decoupled critics are critical for stability because they prevent the bonuses from backing up to pre-intervention states.

limitations: 作者报告：真实人类的纠正动作常常是次优的（"their corrective actions are often suboptimal"），这意味着干预信号本身质量受限。
摘要未报告：10-50% 是相对百分比提升还是百分点提升，也未给出具体基线名称、仿真环境、真实机器人平台与任务数量、参与者样本量及统计显著性。
摘要未报告：基于进度的人类干预模型的具体形式与秩相关系数数值，解耦 critic 的消融细节，以及成功率之外的效率度量。

66e2231979a85c555f677a47a19294322105529b.title: ActPrune: Action-Grounded Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
66e2231979a85c555f677a47a19294322105529b.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform versatile manipulation tasks from language instructions, but their inference cost limits how fast a robot can respond in closed-loop control. Visual token pruning reduces this cost; however, prior methods estimate token redundancy from encoded visual embeddings or attention, only after the visual encoder has processed the entire observation. We propose \ours, a training-free token pruning method that moves the pruning decision ahead of the vision encoder by grounding it in a geometric prior derived from the robot's own action. The action chunk predicted at the previous control step is already available before the current observation is encoded, and it specifies the end-effector and camera motion between consecutive observations. The same action affects the two standard camera views asymmetrically: in the fixed third-person view, \ours retains patches along the projected end-effector trajectory together with semantic anchors, while in the wrist view, it prunes patches that remain unchanged after compensating for the action-induced camera motion. Extensive experiments on two simulation environments (LIBERO and VLABench) and four real-robot tasks demonstrate that \ours achieves up to 1.61 $\times$ speedup and 59.5\% FLOPs reduction with negligible degradation in success rates.

AI.tldr: VLA 模型闭环推理成本高；ActPrune 是一种免训练剪枝方法，用上一步已预测的动作作为几何先验，把剪枝决策提前到视觉编码器之前。在 LIBERO、VLABench 与四个真机任务上，作者报告最高 1.61× 加速、FLOPs 降低 59.5%，成功率下降可忽略。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型能根据语言指令完成多样化操作任务，但推理开销限制了机器人在闭环控制中的响应速度。已有视觉 token 剪枝方法要等视觉编码器处理完整个观测，之后才从编码后的视觉嵌入或注意力中估计 token 冗余，因此剪枝发生得太晚。
AI.method: 输入包括当前观测，以及上一个控制步已经算出的动作块——它尚未编码当前观测就已可用，并描述了相邻观测之间末端执行器与相机的运动。方法免训练，把剪枝决策从编码器之后前移到编码器之前，以该动作导出的几何先验作为判据，并对两个标准相机视角采用不对称策略：在固定的第三人称视角中，保留投影末端执行器轨迹经过的 patch 以及语义锚点；在腕部视角中，先补偿动作引起的相机运动，再剪掉补偿后仍保持不变的 patch。输出是精简后的视觉 token，交由 VLA 策略继续推理（剪枝之外的策略结构在摘要中未描述）。
AI.result: 作者在两个仿真环境（LIBERO、VLABench）和四个真机任务上报告了效率与成功率结果：最高 1.61× 加速、FLOPs 降低 59.5%，成功率下降可忽略。加速为倍数形式，FLOPs 为百分比降幅，两者不等同。摘要未给出具体成功率数值、对比基线、硬件或延迟数据。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作提示：VLA 的感知计算可以借机器人自身的动作预测来做先验约束，从而在视觉编码之前削减视觉 token，属于面向闭环响应速度的部署侧优化，且不涉及额外训练。证据边界是：仅摘要可见，效果由作者自述，具体成功率、基线、硬件与真机/仿真的逐任务数值均未在摘要中报告，未读全文无法核实。
AI.core_method: 用上一控制步预测的动作推算末端执行器与相机运动这一几何先验，在视觉编码之前就决定两个相机视角各自保留或剪掉哪些 patch，全程免训练。

key_results.finding: 作者报告最高 1.61× 加速与 59.5% FLOPs 降低，成功率下降可忽略（绝对值未报告）。
key_results.setting: 两个仿真环境 LIBERO 与 VLABench，外加四个真机任务；对比基线、硬件与逐任务数值摘要未报告
key_results.evidence_quote: Extensive experiments on two simulation environments (LIBERO and VLABench) and four real-robot tasks demonstrate that \ours achieves up to 1.61 $\times$ speedup and 59.5\% FLOPs reduction with negligible degradation in success rates.

239a202193f0ccdddb175f3d69bbab16f830693b.title: STRIDE: Learning Humanoid Locomotion in Minutes with Acceleration-Based Rewards
239a202193f0ccdddb175f3d69bbab16f830693b.summary: Learning locomotion directly on a humanoid robot is a promising direction to avoid the sim-to-real gap. However, locomotion rewards in Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically track the base velocity, which cannot be measured onboard without an external motion capture system or well-calibrated state estimator. This is why we introduce \method{}, which learns humanoid locomotion from minutes of samples with a reward that only requires the onboard Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU). Instead of tracking the base velocity, STRIDE rewards the robot for following a commanded acceleration profile. To learn efficiently from this reward, we use the off-policy RL algorithm XQC and combine a high gain setting for the joint position controllers with left-right symmetry augmentation. In simulation, STRIDE learns to walk on the Unitree G1 and Booster T1 humanoids within 14 minutes of samples. Compared to learning without these two components, it reduces the falls during training by 81%, while without them the robot learns only in over an hour.

AI.tldr: STRIDE 把强化学习的人形行走奖励从“跟踪基座速度”换成“跟随指令加速度曲线”，因此奖励只需机载 IMU；配合 off-policy 算法 XQC、关节位置控制器高增益设置与左右对称增强，摘要称在仿真中 14 分钟样本内让 Unitree G1 与 Booster T1 学会行走。
AI.motivation: 作者指出的具体缺口是：直接在人形机器人上学习运动可绕开 sim-to-real gap，但常用的运动奖励跟踪基座速度，而基座速度无法在不依赖外部动作捕捉系统或标定良好的状态估计器的情况下机载测量。
AI.method: 输入是指令加速度曲线(commanded acceleration profile)与机载 IMU 可测的观测；方法学到的是一套人形运动策略，其奖励不再要求测量或跟踪基座速度，而是奖励机器人跟随给定的加速度曲线。为从该奖励中高效学习，作者采用 off-policy 强化学习算法 XQC，并把关节位置控制器的高增益设置与左右对称增强结合起来。相对基线是去掉“高增益设置”与“左右对称增强”这两个组件的学习版本。
AI.result: 摘要报告的是仿真结果：STRIDE 在 Unitree G1 与 Booster T1 两种人形机器人上，用 14 分钟样本学会行走；与不使用高增益设置和左右对称增强的学习相比，训练期间跌倒减少 81%（相对百分比），而后者的机器人需要超过一小时才学会。摘要未报告绝对跌倒次数、成功率、速度指标、真实机器人实验或与外部方法的数值对比。
AI.conclusion: 对人形运动与世界模型方向的启示是：把奖励信号从基座速度改为指令加速度，可把学习所需的传感前提压缩到机载 IMU，从而为直接在真机上训练留出空间。但证据边界明确——所报告的战绩全部来自仿真，摘要未报告真机部署或 sim-to-real 迁移结果，因此“避免 sim-to-real gap”目前仍是作者的动机陈述而非已验证结论；81% 与 14 分钟的具体条件（样本量、算力、评价“学会行走”的判据）摘要未报告。
AI.core_method: 用“跟随指令加速度曲线”替代“跟踪基座速度”作为奖励，只依赖机载 IMU，并以 off-policy XQC、关节位置控制器高增益与左右对称增强来换取分钟级样本效率。

key_results.finding: 在仿真中，STRIDE 在 Unitree G1 和 Booster T1 两种人形机器人上，用 14 分钟样本学会行走。
key_results.setting: 仿真环境；G1 与 Booster T1 两种人形硬件；摘要未报告对照基线、样本量与“学会行走”的判据。
key_results.evidence_quote: In simulation, STRIDE learns to walk on the Unitree G1 and Booster T1 humanoids within 14 minutes of samples.

key_results.finding: 去掉“高增益设置”和“左右对称增强”两个组件后，训练期间跌倒增加（即使用两组件时相对减少 81%），且没有它们时机器人需要超过一小时才学会。
key_results.setting: 与不使用这两个组件的学习版本对比；摘要未报告绝对跌倒次数、训练时长上限、随机种子或统计显著性。
key_results.evidence_quote: Compared to learning without these two components, it reduces the falls during training by 81%, while without them the robot learns only in over an hour.

limitations: 摘要只报告仿真结果，未报告真实机器人实验或 sim-to-real 迁移；作者仅在动机中提出“直接在真机上学习可避免 sim-to-real gap”。
作者未在摘要中报告自身局限（作者-reported limitations 摘要未报告）；同时未报告 81% 所对应的绝对跌倒次数、样本量或统计显著性。
摘要未报告硬件与训练配置细节，例如控制频率、算力、XQC 超参数，以及除“超过一小时”以外的基线条件。

92ab81c8dd958a4dc3a991f3097a172e8676e963.title: SUGARv2: Learning Diverse Visual Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Skills from Synthesized Interaction References
92ab81c8dd958a4dc3a991f3097a172e8676e963.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Project page: this https URL
92ab81c8dd958a4dc3a991f3097a172e8676e963.summary: Scaling up visual humanoid loco-manipulation skill acquisition requires reducing the human effort needed as tasks and spatial configurations expand, particularly in demonstration collection and task-specific training design. We present SUGARv2, a unified framework for learning diverse visual humanoid loco-manipulation skills through interaction reference synthesis and a shared training pipeline. To obtain diverse references at low cost, we adapt reusable task templates to different spatial configurations, synthesizing coordinated robot and object motions. To reduce task-specific reward design and training effort, we use reference-based imitation as a common learning objective across tasks. We first train privileged teachers to execute these references, then train visual policies through teacher distillation and reinforcement learning with the same reference-based mimic rewards, using diverse object instances and visual domain randomization to support visual generalization and sim-to-real transfer. Across five humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, SUGARv2 achieves a mean success rate of 91.0% in simulation. Deployment on a real humanoid robot further demonstrates successful sim-to-real transfer for whole-body manipulation. These results demonstrate the framework's potential for learning diverse visual humanoid loco-manipulation skills.

AI.tldr: SUGARv2 用「可复用任务模板 + 参考动作合成」低成本生成多样化人形 loco-manipulation 参考，并以统一的参考模仿奖励贯穿教师训练与视觉策略蒸馏+强化学习，在 5 个任务上仿真平均成功率 91.0%，并迁移到真实人形机器人。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，随着任务与空间构型扩展，视觉人形 loco-manipulation 技能获取需要降低人力成本，尤其是示范采集与任务专用训练设计两方面。摘要未报告具体的先前方法失败案例或定量对比。
AI.method: 输入：可复用的任务模板与不同空间构型；方法把模板适配到不同空间布局，合成协调的机器人运动与物体运动，从而得到多样参考轨迹。学习上不再为每个任务单独设计奖励，而是统一采用基于参考的模仿目标：先训练拥有特权信息的教师策略执行这些参考，再通过教师蒸馏与强化学习训练视觉策略，二者共用同一参考模仿奖励；训练中使用多样物体实例与视觉域随机化以支持视觉泛化和仿真到真实迁移。输出：可在视觉输入下执行多类全身 loco-manipulation 的策略。
AI.result: 作者报告在 5 个人形 loco-manipulation 任务上仿真平均成功率为 91.0%；并在真实人形机器人上部署，表明全身操作实现了仿真到真实的迁移。摘要未报告真实机器人成功率、对比基线或具体任务名称。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能而言，该工作提示：用模板化参考合成替代逐任务示范与奖励工程，可能降低人形全身技能的扩展成本，且参考模仿目标可贯穿特权教师与视觉策略。证据限度在于：摘要只给出仿真的一个平均成功率数字，真实机器人侧仅称“成功迁移”而无量化结果，也无与人形 loco-manipulation 基线方法的比较，因此泛化范围与鲁棒性尚不能由摘要判定。
AI.core_method: 把可复用任务模板适配到不同空间构型以合成机器人与物体协调的参考动作，再用统一的参考模仿奖励做特权教师训练与视觉策略蒸馏+强化学习。

key_results.finding: 在真实人形机器人上部署，展示全身操作的成功仿真到真实迁移（摘要未给出数值指标）。
key_results.setting: 真实人形机器人，全身操作；任务、成功率与对比条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Deployment on a real humanoid robot further demonstrates successful sim-to-real transfer for whole-body manipulation.

limitations: 摘要未报告真实机器人上的定量结果（如成功率），仅有“成功迁移”的定性表述。
摘要未报告任何基线方法对比，也未说明 91.0% 的统计口径（如试验次数、方差、显著性）。

cbd890ce1b2d88c0e150af3357f34b4b00695370.title: RevoSim: Scalable Multimodal Tactile Simulation for Dexterous Manipulation
cbd890ce1b2d88c0e150af3357f34b4b00695370.summary: We present RevoSim, a scalable and high-fidelity multimodal tactile simulator for the BrainCo Revo3 hand that jointly models 285 piezoresistive taxels and five visuotactile fingertips. RevoSim efficiently generates synchronized pressure, depth, RGB, and marker-displacement observations; on a single RTX 5090, its depth-conditioned marker-displacement configuration supports up to 4,096 parallel environments. We train in-hand manipulation and grasping policies entirely in simulation, establishing a foundation for future sim-to-real transfer. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: RevoSim 是为 BrainCo Revo3 手构建的可扩展多模态触觉仿真器，联合建模 285 个压阻触觉单元与 5 个视触觉指尖，同步输出压力、深度、RGB 与标记位移观测；作者报告单张 RTX 5090 上深度条件化标记位移配置可支持最多 4,096 个并行环境，并完全在仿真中训练抓取与手内操作策略，作为未来 sim-to-real 迁移的基础。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出目标是可扩展、高保真的多模态触觉仿真，并说明策略完全在仿真中训练、为未来 sim-to-real 迁移奠定基础，即当前仍缺少真机迁移结果。摘要未报告具体的现有仿真器缺陷或失败案例。
AI.method: 输入是 Revo3 手及其两类触觉感知配置：285 个压阻触觉单元和 5 个视触觉指尖。方法把这些传感模态放进同一个仿真器联合建模，并同步生成四类观测——压力、深度、RGB 与标记位移（marker displacement）。其中一种配置为"深度条件化的标记位移"，即用深度条件驱动标记位移的生成。产出是可用于强化学习/策略训练的多模态触觉观测流，以及在该仿真中训练出的抓取与手内操作策略。相对于"未在摘要中说明的基线"，变化在于把压阻触觉阵列与视触觉指尖统一到同一仿真框架并保持观测同步；摘要未说明具体仿真算法、物理建模细节或训练算法。
AI.result: 作者报告两条可量化信息：(1) 仿真器规模：联合建模 285 个压阻触觉单元与 5 个视触觉指尖；(2) 效率：在单张 RTX 5090 上，深度条件化的标记位移配置支持最多 4,096 个并行环境。摘要未报告任何策略成功率、任务基准、与基线的数值对比，也未报告 sim-to-real 迁移结果；作者仅称在仿真中训练了手内操作与抓取策略，并"为未来 sim-to-real 迁移奠定基础"。
AI.conclusion: 对触觉驱动的灵巧操作研究，其价值主张是"多模态触觉观测（压力/深度/RGB/标记位移）在同一仿真器中同步且可大规模并行"，从而支持在仿真内训练抓取与手内操作策略。证据边界很窄：摘要只给出建模规模与并行环境数，没有给出策略性能、保真度验证或真机迁移数据，因此"高保真"和"可扩展"目前是作者主张而非被摘要中的数值验证的结论；迁移到真实机器人尚属未完成的工作。
AI.core_method: 在同一仿真器中联合建模压阻触觉阵列与视触觉指尖，并同步生成压力、深度、RGB 和标记位移观测，用于大规模并行地训练灵巧操作策略。

key_results.finding: 深度条件化的标记位移配置在单张 RTX 5090 上支持最多 4,096 个并行环境。
key_results.setting: 仿真器吞吐/并行度配置，硬件为单张 RTX 5090；摘要未报告与该配置之外的其他配置或基线的对比。
key_results.evidence_quote: on a single RTX 5090, its depth-conditioned marker-displacement configuration supports up to 4,096 parallel environments

limitations: 作者自述的定位是"为未来 sim-to-real 迁移奠定基础"，即摘要未报告任何真实机器人迁移结果。
摘要未报告任何策略成功率、任务基准或与基线的定量对比，因此无法判断所训练策略的实际性能。

7d38f10a47fedf7b6feda8572325216a30e325e8.title: ForPC: Force-Aware Whole-Body Control for Precise Humanoid Cart Pushing
7d38f10a47fedf7b6feda8572325216a30e325e8.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Project website: this https URL . Corresponding author: Cheng Cheng
7d38f10a47fedf7b6feda8572325216a30e325e8.summary: Humanoid robots are expected to take over strenuous material handling in manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare, where operating existing wheeled carts would let them move heavy loads without modifying the workplace. However, humanoid cart pushing remains challenging because the bimanual grasp closes a force-coupled loop in which the contact wrenches that drive the cart also disturb the robot's balance, and payload changes alter the coupled dynamics. We propose ForPC, a force-aware whole-body control framework that regulates cart velocity through two-stage reinforcement learning. A locomotion prior is first trained under varied hand loads and upper-body postures to provide balance support. A force latent and a state latent are then inferred from onboard observations, without external force sensors, and fed to a residual policy that coordinates bounded arm, waist, and leg adjustments with base-velocity commands. Multi-objective rewards penalize bimanual internal opposition, grasp slip, and actuator saturation, encouraging the policy to apply contact force on demand without human demonstrations. Sim-to-sim experiments show that ForPC reduces cart-velocity RMSE by up to 68.2% relative to a locomotion-only baseline (Loco-only) and cross-track RMSE by up to 74.2% on the multi-bend route. Trained solely in simulation, the policy also transfers to a physical Unitree G1 without real-world training or fine-tuning and, with no payload-specific adjustment, pushes a cart carrying up to 30 kg at 0.5 m/s. These results suggest that humanoid robots could eventually replace humans for efficient material handling in daily life.

AI.tldr: ForPC 用两阶段强化学习做人形机器人推车：先训练负载与姿态变化下的运动先验保平衡，再用从机载观测推断的力/状态隐变量驱动残差策略调手臂、腰、腿与基座速度。仿真中相对仅运动基线（Loco-only）把车体速度 RMSE 最多降低 68.2%、多弯道路线横向 RMSE 最多降低 74.2%，并零微调迁移到实体 Unitree G1，推动载重最高 30 kg 的车以 0.5 m/s 前进。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出：在制造、物流、医疗中，人形机器人若能操作现有轮式推车，就可在不改造工作场所的前提下搬运重物。但双臂抓握会形成力耦合闭环——驱动推车的接触力旋量同时扰动机器人平衡，且载荷变化会改变耦合动力学，使推车任务仍然困难。
AI.method: 输入是机载观测（不使用外部力传感器）。第一阶段在变化的手部负载与上肢姿态下训练一个运动先验，提供平衡支撑。第二阶段从机载观测中推断出力隐变量与状态隐变量，送入残差策略；该策略在基座速度指令之上协调有界的手臂、腰部和腿部调整，从而调节推车速度。训练目标为多目标奖励，惩罚双臂内对抗、抓握滑移和执行器饱和，使策略按需施加接触力，且不使用人类示范。输出是可用于真机的全身控制策略（速度调节行为）。相对基线是仅运动的 Loco-only 策略。
AI.result: 作者报告：在 sim-to-sim 实验中，相对仅运动基线（Loco-only），车体速度 RMSE 最多降低 68.2%，多弯道路线上横向（cross-track）RMSE 最多降低 74.2%，均为相对百分比降低。仅在仿真中训练的策略零真实训练、零微调迁移到实体 Unitree G1，且无需按载荷调整，即可推动载重最高 30 kg 的推车以 0.5 m/s 行进。真机部分未报告 RMSE 等量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能的意义在于：把接触力耦合与平衡解耦为“运动先验 + 力/状态隐变量残差策略”的两阶段结构，并宣称可在无外部力传感器、无人类示范的条件下实现人形全身推车。证据边界：量化对比只在 sim-to-sim 中相对 Loco-only 给出；真机仅报告迁移成功与载重/速度，未报告量化误差或与其他方法的比较；作者用“could eventually replace humans”表述，属展望而非已验证结论。
AI.core_method: 两阶段强化学习：先学一个在负载与上肢姿态变化下保持平衡的运动先验，再从机载观测推断力与状态隐变量，用残差策略在基座速度指令上叠加有界的手臂、腰、腿调整来调节推车速度。

key_results.finding: 相对仅运动基线（Loco-only），车体速度 RMSE 最多降低 68.2%（相对百分比）。
key_results.setting: sim-to-sim 实验；基线为 Loco-only；指标为 cart-velocity RMSE；具体路线与载荷条件摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: Sim-to-sim experiments show that ForPC reduces cart-velocity RMSE by up to 68.2% relative to a locomotion-only baseline (Loco-only)

key_results.finding: 在多弯道路线上，横向（cross-track）RMSE 最多降低 74.2%（相对百分比）。
key_results.setting: sim-to-sim 实验；任务为多弯道路线；比较对象为同一 Loco-only 基线；具体弯道数量与速度摘要未报告。
key_results.evidence_quote: and cross-track RMSE by up to 74.2% on the multi-bend route

key_results.finding: 仅在仿真中训练的策略无需真实训练或微调即迁移到实体 Unitree G1，并在不做载荷专属调整的情况下推动载重最高 30 kg 的推车以 0.5 m/s 行进。
key_results.setting: 真机（physical Unitree G1）；零真实世界训练、零微调；无载荷专属调整；未报告真机量化误差指标。
key_results.evidence_quote: Trained solely in simulation, the policy also transfers to a physical Unitree G1 without real-world training or fine-tuning and, with no payload-specific adjustment, pushes a cart carrying up to 30 kg at 0.5 m/s.

limitations: 摘要未报告真机量化指标（如速度/横向 RMSE、成功率或与基线的真机对比），真机结论仅为迁移成功与载重/速度描述。
摘要未报告除 Loco-only 之外的对比基线，也未报告消融实验、样本量或统计显著性。
摘要未报告力隐变量/状态隐变量的推断精度、传感器配置细节、控制频率或计算开销；也未报告所宣称的力隐变量在无外部力传感器条件下的验证方式。

65bbc848ecdbe2565854a39a2446b9d768dd092a.title: ToolDex: An Ego-Exo Human Demonstration Dataset for Creative Physical Tool Use
65bbc848ecdbe2565854a39a2446b9d768dd092a.summary: Creative tool use is a fundamental human capability and an important step toward general-purpose embodied intelligence. It requires agents to reason about object affordances, physical constraints, and manipulation strategies, especially when standard tools are unavailable. However, progress in this area is limited by the lack of real-world datasets that capture human tool-use behavior with sufficient scale, fidelity, and diversity. Existing benchmarks are often simulation-based, focus on simplified interactions, or lack detailed observations and annotations. We introduce ToolDex, a large-scale egocentric-exocentric (ego-exo) human demonstration dataset for creative physical tool use. ToolDex captures scenarios in which humans select, adapt, and repurpose available objects as tools. Using synchronized egocentric cameras and eight exocentric cameras, the dataset provides high-fidelity multi-view observations and rich annotations for hands, tools, target objects, and their deformable interactions. Beyond data collection, we establish a benchmark suite characterizing three core capabilities: physical tool-use reasoning, sparse-view 3D and 4D reconstruction, and robot policy learning. ToolDex provides a foundation for studying human tool-use behavior and developing embodied agents that can adaptively use tools in complex real-world environments. Dataset visualizations and benchmarking results are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对创新性实物工具使用缺乏大规模真实数据的问题，作者提出 ToolDex：一个同步自我中心—外部视角（ego-exo）的人类演示数据集，并配套三项能力的基准测试。摘要未给出任何数值结果。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出，创新性工具使用要求智能体推理物体可供性、物理约束与操作策略，尤其在缺少标准工具时；而现有基准多为仿真环境、只关注简化交互，或缺乏细致观测与标注，因此该领域缺乏兼具规模、保真度与多样性的真实世界数据集。
AI.method: 输入是真实世界中人类选择、改造、把现有物体当作工具使用的演示过程。采集上用同步的自我中心相机加八台外部视角相机，形成多视角高保真观测；标注覆盖手、工具、目标物体及其可变形交互。相对摘要所述现有基准（多为仿真、交互简化、标注不足），该方法的变化在于提供真实多视角、带交互标注的人类工具使用数据，并由此建立覆盖物理工具使用推理、稀疏视角 3D 与 4D 重建、机器人策略学习三项能力的基准套件。产出是数据集本身加基准套件与可视化结果。
AI.result: 作者宣称 ToolDex 是大规模 ego-exo 人类工具使用演示数据集，并建立了覆盖物理工具使用推理、稀疏视角 3D/4D 重建、机器人策略学习三项能力的基准套件；摘要提到可视化与基准结果可通过链接获取，但未报告任何任务指标、数值、单位或对照基线，也未给出数据集规模数字，因此无法给出定量结论。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与工具使用研究而言，该工作的贡献是真实世界多视角人类工具使用数据与配套评测方向的搭建，可作为研究人类工具使用行为、以及开发能自适应使用工具的具身智能体的基础。由于摘要未报告任何定量结果与规模，其对方法有效性的证据仅停留在数据与基准的提出层面，未被数值验证。
AI.core_method: 用同步的自我中心相机与八台外部视角相机录制人类把现有物体当作工具使用的真实演示，并标注手、工具、目标物体及其可变形交互，再据此构建三项能力的基准。
limitations: 作者在摘要中提出的现有工作不足：现有基准多为仿真、聚焦简化交互或缺少细致观测与标注（属作者对领域的判断，非本文自身局限）。
摘要未报告数据集规模（场景数、演示条数、参与人数）、标注一致性或统计显著性等细节。
摘要未报告任何基准数值结果、基线对比，也未说明是否包含真实机器人实验或仅有离线数据与重建评估。

ab4e632d32d60dc8b8ec417a5981348e33acf5c3.title: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
ab4e632d32d60dc8b8ec417a5981348e33acf5c3.summary: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. A correction encoder and adapter absorb this knowledge into policy weights during training, while fresh codes adapt behavior with frozen weights at deployment. The action model, A2-WLA, adds motion-aware history and a latent world model to a vision-language-action policy. Surprisingly, this simple design with action pretraining and task specialization reaches 0.5755 Q-score on the 50-task BEHAVIOR 2026 public subset before online correction, 2.21x the 2025 winner's reported 0.2605 across different benchmark editions and training configurations. On all 100 BEHAVIOR 2026 public tasks, A2-MEAS achieves 0.6411 Q-score and 45.40% task success. On RoboTwin 2.0, A2-WLA achieves 93.98% average success, rising to 95.05% with the complete system. Across 12 real-robot tasks in five household settings, A2-WLA achieves 57.92% average success versus 26.67% for pi0.5. In long-horizon pour-over coffee preparation, a history-conditioned adapter raises post-failure completion at two filter-handling steps from 14% to 94% and from 8% to 82%, compared with A2-WLA retries. Our training infrastructure delivers 427.1 samples per second, 4.03x the throughput of a pi0.5 reference implementation on matched hardware. We will release the system, models, training scripts, and infrastructure to support efficient embodied learning.

AI.tldr: A2-MEAS 是一个以"代码"为扩展接口的具身多智能体框架：用学习到的纠错代码把纠错语言、空间证据、执行历史与动作提议注入策略，训练时写入权重、部署时以冻结权重做在线纠错。摘要报告 BEHAVIOR 2026 公开子集 0.5755 Q-score、12 项真机任务 57.92% 平均成功率，以及训练吞吐 427.1 samples/s。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出基础模型越来越多地驱动机器人动作，但持续自主仍需要高效控制与失败恢复；因此需要一种能同时解决"高效控制"和"失败后恢复"的具身多智能体方案。
AI.method: 输入是纠错语言、空间证据、执行历史与动作提议，被组合成"学习到的纠错代码"。系统由 MetaBrain 提供训练监督与运行时指导；纠错编码器与适配器在训练阶段把这些知识吸收进策略权重，部署阶段则保持权重冻结、用新生成的代码在线调整行为。动作模型 A2-WLA 在视觉-语言-动作策略之上加入运动感知历史与潜世界模型。相对基线的改变是加入代码化的纠错接口与上述两个模块，输出是可在训练后被吸收、部署时被在线纠错修正的机器人动作策略。
AI.result: 摘要报告多重结果：BEHAVIOR 2026 的 50 任务公开子集上，在线纠错前达到 0.5755 Q-score，为 2025 年获胜者所报告 0.2605 的 2.21x（作者注明两者来自不同基准版本与训练配置）；全部 100 个 BEHAVIOR 2026 公开任务上 0.6411 Q-score、45.40% 任务成功率；RoboTwin 2.0 上 A2-WLA 平均成功率 93.98%，完整系统升至 95.05%；五类家庭场景 12 项真机任务中 A2-WLA 平均成功率 57.92%，pi0.5 为 26.67%；长程手冲咖啡中历史条件化适配器把两个滤纸操作步骤的失败后完成率从 14% 提升到 94%、从 8% 提升到 82%（对比 A2-WLA 重试）；训练基础设施 427.1 samples/s，为匹配硬件上 pi0.5 参考实现的 4.03x 吞吐。作者称将开源系统、模型、训练脚本与基础设施。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向的意义在于：把"纠错知识"做成可训练吸收、也可部署时在线使用的代码接口，并在策略内加入潜世界模型与运动感知历史，同时覆盖仿真基准、真机与长程失败恢复。但证据边界明确：跨版本比较由作者自行标注为不同基准版本与训练配置，真机结果仅来自摘要所述的 12 项任务/五类家庭场景，摘要未给出消融、样本量或统计显著性。
AI.core_method: 把纠错语言、空间证据、执行历史与动作提议编码成"纠错代码"，训练时经编码器与适配器写入策略权重，部署时在权重冻结下用新代码在线纠错行为。

key_results.finding: 在线纠错之前，在 BEHAVIOR 2026 的 50 任务公开子集上取得 0.5755 Q-score，作者称其为 2025 年获胜者所报告 0.2605 的 2.21x（作者注明两者跨越不同基准版本与训练配置）。
key_results.setting: BEHAVIOR 2026 50 任务公开子集；对比对象为 2025 年获胜者报告的 0.2605；作者明确该对比跨不同基准版本与训练配置。
key_results.evidence_quote: Surprisingly, this simple design with action pretraining and task specialization reaches 0.5755 Q-score on the 50-task BEHAVIOR 2026 public subset before online correction, 2.21x the 2025 winner's reported 0.2605 across different benchmark editions and training configurations.

key_results.finding: 在五类家庭场景的 12 项真机任务上，A2-WLA 平均成功率 57.92%，高于 pi0.5 的 26.67%。
key_results.setting: 真机实验：12 项任务、五类家庭场景；对比基线为 pi0.5。
key_results.evidence_quote: Across 12 real-robot tasks in five household settings, A2-WLA achieves 57.92% average success versus 26.67% for pi0.5.

key_results.finding: 在长程手冲咖啡制备中，历史条件化适配器把两个滤纸处理步骤的失败后完成率分别从 14% 提升到 94%、从 8% 提升到 82%（对比 A2-WLA 重试）。
key_results.setting: 长程手冲咖啡制备任务，评价指标为失败后完成率（post-failure completion），对比条件为 A2-WLA 重试。
key_results.evidence_quote: In long-horizon pour-over coffee preparation, a history-conditioned adapter raises post-failure completion at two filter-handling steps from 14% to 94% and from 8% to 82%, compared with A2-WLA retries.

limitations: 作者自行标注的比较局限：0.5755 与 0.2605 的对比跨越不同基准版本与训练配置（"across different benchmark editions and training configurations"），不是同条件对比。
摘要未报告消融实验、样本量或统计显著性；MetaBrain、纠错编码器/适配器、潜世界模型各组件分别贡献多少无法从摘要判断。
摘要未报告真机任务的硬件平台、物体/场景细节、失败案例或部署延迟；作者表示将开源系统、模型、训练脚本与基础设施，但摘要未报告具体释放时间或链接。

92540c55e2b3f301026738a48a82fc1a35b35d54.title: MDF++: Visuo-Tactile World Action Model with End-to-end Representation Learning
92540c55e2b3f301026738a48a82fc1a35b35d54.summary: Recently, world-action models (WAMs) have emerged as a powerful framework for robot manipulation. By jointly modeling action generation and future observation prediction, WAMs can act and anticipate the outcomes of the actions. However, existing WAMs typically rely on frozen pretrained encoders trained with reconstruction, which may not produce representations well suited for robot control. In this paper, we tackle the problem of learning physicallygrounded, control-relevant representations for WAMs. We propose MDF++, a visuo-tactile world-action model that learns latent representations of multisensory observations end-to-end with a diffusion backbone. While naive joint training can lead to feature collapse, MDF++ introduces a multi-task learning strategy that leverages cross-modal correlations to learn task-relevant representations. We evaluate MDF++ on a suite of contact-rich manipulation tasks, including realworld bolt screwing and nut mating, and show that it outperforms WAMs built on frozen pretrained representations by up to 50%. Additional videos are available on our website: this http URL .

AI.tldr: 现有世界-动作模型依赖冻结的重建式预训练编码器，表征未必适合机器人控制。MDF++ 用扩散主干端到端学习视触觉多感官潜表征，并以多任务学习利用跨模态相关性，在接触丰富的操作任务上优于冻结表征的WAM，最高提升50%。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出现有WAM通常使用以重建目标训练的冻结预训练编码器，这类表征可能不适合机器人控制；论文由此切入"为WAM学习物理扎根、与控制相关的表征"这一问题。
AI.method: 输入为视触觉多感官观测；方法不再使用冻结的重建式编码器，而是与扩散主干联合、端到端地学习观测的潜表征，输出用于动作生成与未来观测预测。由于朴素联合训练会导致特征坍缩，作者引入多任务学习策略，利用跨模态相关性来获得任务相关表征。与基线的关键差别在于编码器可训练且目标面向控制，而非冻结重建表征。
AI.result: 作者报告在包含真实世界螺栓拧入与螺母对位的接触丰富操作任务上，MDF++ 优于基于冻结预训练表征的WAM，提升幅度最高达50%；摘要未给出具体基准指标名称、绝对数值、样本量或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型研究而言，该工作提示WAM的观测编码器应与控制目标一同学习，并用触觉等跨模态信息稳定表征、缓解特征坍缩。证据仅限摘要：提升幅度为作者自报的"up to 50%"，任务细节、基线配置与评测协议未在摘要中给出，需读全文核实。
AI.core_method: 把视触觉观测编码器与扩散世界-动作主干端到端联合训练，并用跨模态多任务学习避免特征坍缩。

key_results.finding: MDF++在接触丰富操作任务上优于基于冻结预训练表征的WAM，提升最高达50%。
key_results.setting: 接触丰富操作任务套件，含真实世界螺栓拧入与螺母对位；基线为使用冻结预训练表征的WAM；摘要未报告具体指标名称与绝对数值。
key_results.evidence_quote: We evaluate MDF++ on a suite of contact-rich manipulation tasks, including realworld bolt screwing and nut mating, and show that it outperforms WAMs built on frozen pretrained representations by up to 50%.

key_results.finding: 朴素联合训练可导致特征坍缩，MDF++以利用跨模态相关性的多任务学习策略应对。
key_results.setting: 方法层面的观察与设计动机；摘要未报告该现象的定量测量。
key_results.evidence_quote: While naive joint training can lead to feature collapse, MDF++ introduces a multi-task learning strategy that leverages cross-modal correlations to learn task-relevant representations.

limitations: 作者在摘要中报告的设计性限制：朴素联合训练会导致特征坍缩，需要额外的多任务学习策略。
摘要未报告：50%提升对应的具体评测指标、任务数量、试验次数与统计显著性。
摘要未报告：仿真与真实实验的划分细节、计算开销或推理延迟。</br>

aae6fb142161d777d849d7029c967cfffb0a7acd.title: Meituan-Robotics-0: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Desktop Manipulation
aae6fb142161d777d849d7029c967cfffb0a7acd.comment: 25 pages. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL
aae6fb142161d777d849d7029c967cfffb0a7acd.summary: We present Meituan-Robotics-0 (MR0), a vision-language-action foundation model and embodied-agent system for stationary-base desktop manipulation. MR0 combines 147 million vision-language samples with 15,060 hours of curated robot trajectories spanning 12 embodiments. A three-stage training recipe aligns multimodal representations with robot behavior through discrete action-token pre-training, transfers these priors to continuous cross-embodiment control through flow-matching mid-training, and adapts the policy through real-world post-training. We introduce Rollback, which pairs replaced policy segments with human corrections to provide positive and negative supervision for CFG-DAgger without value learning or advantage labeling. A unified end-effector interface supports heterogeneous embodiments, while asynchronous action-chunk merging maintains smooth execution under variable inference latency. An event-driven agent maintains persistent task events and reassesses plans when progress or feasibility changes, enabling cross-task retrieval and conditional task resumption. MR0 achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ranks fifth in the RoboDojo VLA track. Under matched HG-DAgger post-training, MR0 achieves higher average success rate and progress score than $\pi_{0.5}$ across three real-robot tasks. On Ethernet insertion, CFG-DAgger trained with Rollback data reaches 70% success and a progress score of 0.90. Qualitative agent deployments demonstrate cross-task event retrieval and recovery from temporarily unsatisfied task conditions.

AI.tldr: MR0 是面向固定底座桌面操作的多模态视觉-语言-动作基础模型与具身智能体系统，用三阶段训练把离散动作 token 预训练先验迁移到连续跨本体控制，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达 93.6% 成功率，并在真实机器人任务上超过 π0.5。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出目标是固定底座的桌面操作这一具体场景，需要统一异构本体接口、在推理延迟波动下保持执行平滑，并在任务进度或可行性变化时重新规划；同时人机纠错监督通常依赖价值学习或优势标注。摘要未报告现有方法的具体失败模式或定量差距。
AI.method: 输入为 1.47 亿视觉-语言样本与 15,060 小时、覆盖 12 种本体的机器人轨迹。方法分三阶段：先用离散动作 token 做预训练，把多模态表示与机器人行为对齐；再用流匹配（flow-matching）中期训练把先验迁移到连续跨本体控制；最后通过真实世界后训练适配策略。数据侧提出 Rollback，把被替换的策略片段与人类纠正配对，为 CFG-DAgger 提供正负监督，无需价值学习或优势标注。系统侧用统一末端执行器接口支持异构本体，用异步动作块合并应对可变推理延迟以保持执行平滑；事件驱动的智能体维护持久任务事件，进度或可行性变化时重新评估计划，支持跨任务检索与条件式任务恢复。输出为桌面操作策略与具身智能体行为。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 取得 93.6% 成功率，在 RoboDojo VLA 赛道排名第五。在与 HG-DAgger 匹配的后训练条件下，MR0 在三个真实机器人任务上的平均成功率与进度分数高于 π0.5。以太网插入任务中，用 Rollback 数据训练的 CFG-DAgger 达到 70% 成功率与 0.90 的进度分数。定性结果显示智能体可跨任务检索事件并从暂时不满足的任务条件中恢复。摘要未报告延迟、样本量、显著性检验或消融结果。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能/世界模型方向的意义在于：把大规模视觉-语言预训练、离散到连续的动作表示迁移、以及人机纠错数据的高效利用串成一条可跨 12 种本体的桌面操作流水线，并用事件驱动机制处理任务级恢复。证据边界：所有数值均为作者报告，摘要未给出 RoboTwin 2.0 的对比基线、统计细节或真实机器人任务的绝对数值与任务定义，排名第五也未说明赛道规模与评测条件；摘要中的 agent 结论仅为定性描述。
AI.core_method: 先用离散动作 token 对齐多模态与行为，再用流匹配中期训练迁移到连续跨本体控制，最后用真实机器人后训练适配，并以配对纠错的 Rollback 数据监督 dagger 式策略修正。
